66362.recognize_zh: 心包液抹片中一顆大型單核細胞，核圓且居中、核膜平滑，細胞質豐富且外圈顏色較深，表面有一圈小泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs）；這種兩色調細胞質加表面泡突是反應性間皮細胞的典型線索。
features: Large single cell, several times the size of the adjacent lymphocyte, with a moderate N:C ratio
Round, centrally placed nucleus with smooth contour and dense but evenly distributed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Abundant cytoplasm with a two-tone appearance (paler perinuclear zone, denser peripheral rim)
Multiple knob-like cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions around the cell surface
Background of numerous crenated red cells, a small lymphocyte, and scattered degenerated cells
66362.describe_en: Cytocentrifuged pericardial fluid shows a hemorrhagic background with numerous crenated red cells, an occasional small lymphocyte, and degenerated cells. A large single cell with a round, central nucleus, smooth nuclear membrane, and evenly distributed chromatin is present. The cytoplasm is abundant with a denser peripheral zone and a rim of knob-like surface blebs. No marked nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, or abnormal mitoses are seen. Findings are consistent with a reactive mesothelial cell.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells usually form three-dimensional clusters or acini, show nuclear pleomorphism, irregular membranes, prominent nucleoli and cytoplasmic vacuolation, and constitute a second foreign population distinct from mesothelial cells.
Plasma cells have an eccentric nucleus with a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, not a central nucleus with a two-tone rim of surface blebs.
Macrophages have eccentric bean-shaped nuclei and foamy or vacuolated cytoplasm with phagocytosed debris rather than dense peripheral cytoplasm with blebs.
Morphology overlaps; large papillary clusters, marked atypia, and loss of BAP1 or CDKN2A deletion favor mesothelioma over a reactive process.

66426.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血組織被流線狀、漩渦狀排列的梭形纖維組織取代，其間散在形態怪異的巨核細胞：核深染、呈拉長或有角的形狀，分葉不良，排列紊亂；這種「纖維化背景加異型巨核細胞」是骨髓纖維化的特徵。
features: Diffuse fibrosis with streaming and swirling spindle-cell fascicles replacing normal marrow
Scattered atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, elongated, angular, or cloud-like poorly lobated nuclei
Megakaryocytes vary in size and appear distorted and stretched along the fibrous streams
Marked reduction of normal hematopoietic cells and fat; small clear spaces/dilated sinusoids scattered throughout
Portion of a bony trabecula at the upper right edge
66426.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section shows diffuse replacement of the marrow by fibrous tissue with streaming and swirling fascicles of spindle cells, with a bony trabecula at the upper right edge. Scattered megakaryocytes are atypical, varying in size, with hyperchromatic, elongated, angular, and poorly lobated nuclei, and are distorted along the direction of the fibrosis. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis and marrow fat are markedly reduced, and small dilated sinusoidal spaces are present. Reticulin and trichrome stains are needed to grade fibrosis. Findings are consistent with the fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis, in correlation with driver mutation studies.

ddx.dx: Post-polycythemia vera or post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: Histology is similar, so a documented prior PV or ET history is required for this designation.
Megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated micromegakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes rather than large hyperchromatic cloud-like forms, and dysplasia is seen in other lineages.
Cohesive epithelial clusters that are keratin-positive are present within the fibrosis, and megakaryocytes lack MPN-type atypia.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia or acute panmyelosis with myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: Sheets of CD34+/CD61+ blasts are present on IHC with a rapid clinical course, rather than mature atypical megakaryocytes.

66234.recognize_zh: 十二格組合圖：前段小腸標本（A–F）見大量背靠背濾泡，CD20、CD10、BCL2 陽性濾泡（BCL6 弱），為濾泡性淋巴瘤；後段淋巴結（G–L）轉為大型多形 Reed-Sternberg 樣細胞（G），CD30 膜與高基氏區陽性（H）、CD15 部分陽性（I）、PAX5 弱陽性（J）、MUM1 強陽性（K）、CD20 陰性（L），符合轉化為古典何杰金淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A (H&E, low power): small bowel wall replaced by numerous crowded, back-to-back nodular follicles
Panels B, C, E: follicles are CD20 positive, CD10 positive and BCL2 positive; Panel D: BCL6 weak at this scanning magnification
Panel F (H&E): area with diffuse growth pattern
Panel G (H&E, high power): large pleomorphic cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent eosinophilic nucleoli and binucleate Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like forms
Panels H-K: large cells show membranous and Golgi CD30, subset CD15, dim nuclear PAX5 and strong MUM1
Panel L: large cells are CD20 negative with only scattered small positive background B cells
66234.describe_en: The initial small bowel resection shows effacement by closely packed neoplastic follicles that are CD20, CD10 and BCL2 positive, with weak BCL6 staining at low power, and a focal diffuse area, consistent with follicular lymphoma. A later lymph node biopsy shows sheets of large pleomorphic cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent macronucleoli and binucleate Reed-Sternberg-like forms. These cells express CD30 in a membranous and Golgi pattern, CD15 in a subset, dim PAX5 and MUM1, and are negative for CD20. The findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma arising from follicular lymphoma, with the reported identical IGH rearrangement supporting clonal relationship.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (usual transformation of FL)
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are strongly CD20 and PAX5 positive and CD15 negative, whereas these large cells are CD20 negative with dim PAX5 and CD15 positivity.
ALCL is PAX5 negative, often expresses T-cell markers and cytotoxic granules and shows TCR clonality, whereas here PAX5 is dim positive and TCR was polyclonal.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma with scattered HRS-like cells (composite pattern)
ddx.vs: HRS-like cells within an FL background retain FL architecture, whereas the later node shows no residual FL morphology.

ddx.dx: Grey zone lymphoma (mediastinal-type large B-cell lymphoma with cHL features)
ddx.vs: Grey zone lymphoma shows sheets of cells with strong CD20 and intact B-cell program, unlike the CD20-negative, dim PAX5 cells here.

66234.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, CD10, BCL6, BCL2, CD30, CD15, PAX5, MUM1

66042.recognize_zh: 一群中大型不成熟骨髓性細胞，核染色質細緻、核輪廓不規則或摺疊，胞質中度嗜鹼性、顆粒不多；下方一顆細胞胞質內可見細長粉紅色 Auer 小體，右側深藍胞質、圓核的細胞為早期紅血球前驅細胞，此組合在臨床上須優先排除 APL。
features: Cluster of medium-to-large immature myeloid cells with fine chromatin and irregular, folded or indented nuclear contours
Moderate amounts of basophilic cytoplasm with sparse fine granules and a pale paranuclear zone in some cells
A slender pink Auer rod in the cytoplasm of one cell in the lower part of the cluster
Immature erythroid precursor with round nucleus, coarser chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (right of cluster)
Background of normochromic red cells and scattered small platelets; no faggot cells seen in this field
66042.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of medium-to-large immature myeloid cells with fine chromatin, irregular or folded nuclear contours and moderately basophilic cytoplasm containing sparse fine granules. One cell contains a single slender Auer rod. An immature erythroid precursor with deeply basophilic cytoplasm is present adjacent to the cluster. Coarse hypergranularity and bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells) are not seen in this field. Findings are suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia, likely a hypogranular pattern; urgent PML::RARA testing and coagulation studies are required for confirmation.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation or other non-APL AML
ddx.vs: Non-APL myeloblasts usually have round nuclei, prominent nucleoli and are CD34+/HLA-DR+, whereas APL cells show folded bilobed nuclei and are CD34-/HLA-DR- with PML::RARA.
Monoblasts and promonocytes have more abundant gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, delicately folded nuclei, strong nonspecific esterase and CD14/CD11b/CD64 expression, and rarely Auer rods.
NPM1-mutated AML can be CD34-/HLA-DR- but shows cup-like nuclear invaginations and lacks PML::RARA.

65850.recognize_zh: H&E 為混合小淋巴球、組織球與間質的多形性浸潤；CD30 與 CD15 只標記少數散在大型細胞（膜狀與高基氏體點狀），PAX5 在大型細胞呈弱陽性，MUM1 大型細胞強陽性——這組合就是典型的 Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg 細胞免疫表型；FISH 可見 IGH::CCND1 融合訊號，連結先前的被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: H&E: polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and scattered larger cells with sclerotic stroma; diagnostic HRS cells not well resolved at this magnification
CD30: scattered large cells with membranous and Golgi/dot-like staining; background negative
CD15: rare large cells with membranous/Golgi staining
PAX5: weak nuclear staining in scattered large cells, dimmer than expected for normal B cells (few B cells in background)
MUM1: strong nuclear staining of large cells plus many smaller background cells
FISH with t(11;14) dual-fusion probe: interphase nuclei with yellow/overlapping fusion signals in addition to separate red and green signals
65850.describe_en: Lymph node section shows effacement by a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes and histiocytes within fibrous stroma, with scattered large cells. By immunohistochemistry, the large cells are CD30-positive with membranous and Golgi staining, CD15-positive in a subset, weakly PAX5-positive and strongly MUM1-positive, typical of Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells; the background lacks a mantle cell lymphoma population. FISH with an IGH::CCND1 dual-fusion probe shows fusion signals, which per the case were localized to the Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, indicating clonal relationship to the preceding mantle cell lymphoma. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma harboring IGH::CCND1, clonally related to prior mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Recurrent mantle cell lymphoma with Hodgkin-like cells
ddx.vs: MCL shows a monotonous sheet of CD20+/CD5+/cyclin D1+ small cells, whereas here the background lacks such cells and the large cells are CD30/CD15 positive with weak PAX5 and CD20 negativity.

ddx.dx: Nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma with HRS-like cells
ddx.vs: TFH lymphoma has atypical background T cells with PD1/ICOS/CXCL13 expression and FDC expansion, which were absent here (intact CD2/5/7, no TFH phenotype, no CD21/CD23 meshworks).
ALCL forms cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30, lacks PAX5 and usually CD15, unlike the scattered PAX5-weak CD15+ HRS cells.
EBV+ DLBCL shows sheets of large CD20+ B cells and is EBER-positive, whereas these cells are CD20-negative, EBER-negative and scattered.

65850.stain: H&E; IHC: CD30, CD15, PAX5, MUM1; FISH IGH::CCND1

65786.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖，不是形態學影像：CD45 強、低側散射的異常母細胞樣群約佔 89.6%，表現 CD2、表面 CD3、CD7 與 TCRγδ，CD5 與 CD56 陰性，CD34 與 CD1a 陰性；成熟 γδ T 細胞表型並失去 CD5，支持肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤而非 T-ALL。
features: SSC versus CD45: atypical blastoid cells (red) ~89.6% with bright CD45 and low side scatter; residual granulocytes (green) ~4.5%
CD2 positive with CD5 negative on the abnormal population, versus CD5-positive normal T lymphocytes (blue, ~2%)
Surface CD3 positive and CD7 positive; CD56 negative on the abnormal cells, with a separate CD7+/CD3- NK population (brown)
sCD3 versus TCR gamma-delta shows co-expression on the abnormal population (3 vs GD gate), distinct from TCR gamma-delta negative normal T cells
CD34 negative and CD1a negative, indicating a mature (post-thymic) T-cell phenotype
65786.describe_en: This figure shows flow cytometry plots rather than a morphologic image. A dominant population of atypical blastoid cells (approximately 90% of events) shows bright CD45 and low side scatter and expresses CD2, surface CD3, CD7 and TCR gamma-delta, with loss of CD5 and absence of CD56, CD34 and CD1a. Residual CD5-positive normal T cells, NK cells and granulocytes serve as internal controls. The mature gamma-delta T-cell phenotype with aberrant CD5 loss and absence of immaturity markers is consistent with a gamma-delta T-cell lymphoma and, in the clinical and genetic context of this case, hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: T-ALL expresses immaturity markers such as TdT, CD34 or CD1a and often lacks surface CD3, whereas these cells are sCD3+, CD34- and CD1a-.
T-LGL cells are usually CD8 and CD57 positive with granular morphology and are not blastoid.
MEITL is often gamma-delta and CD56 positive, CD8 positive and presents as an intestinal mass rather than a leukemic hepatosplenic picture.
Reactive gamma-delta cells retain CD5 and do not constitute the vast majority of events.

65018.recognize_zh: 兩顆中型淋巴球的細胞核明顯多葉、摺疊呈花瓣/腦迴狀（上方細胞較典型），染色質緻密、細胞質少，符合 Sézary 細胞；但這種較粗大的分葉型態也需與 ATLL 的花瓣細胞（flower cell）鑑別，細緻的腦迴狀溝紋在此解析度下不明顯。
features: Two medium-sized lymphoid cells, slightly larger than adjacent red cells
High N:C ratio with scant pale blue cytoplasm
Markedly convoluted, lobulated nuclei: upper cell with multiple petal-like lobes, lower cell with cleaved, clover-like lobation
Dense chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Fine linear cerebriform grooves are not well resolved at this image resolution
Background red cells and a platelet
65018.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows two atypical lymphoid cells of medium size with scant cytoplasm and dense chromatin. The nuclei are markedly convoluted and lobulated, with a petal-like multilobated nucleus in the upper cell and a cleaved clover-like nucleus in the lower cell; fine cerebriform grooves are not clearly resolved at this resolution. No nucleoli or cytoplasmic granules are seen. In a patient with mycosis fungoides, these convoluted lymphocytes are consistent with circulating Sezary cells, although the coarse lobation resembles ATLL flower cells, and flow cytometry (CD4+, CD7-, CD26-) is needed to quantify the clone.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells have coarser, more deeply separated petal-like lobes and are HTLV-1 positive with bright CD25, whereas Sezary cells show fine cerebriform grooves and are CD26 negative.
T-PLL cells have a visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs with round to irregular nuclei, TCL1 overexpression and inv(14)/t(14;14).
Reactive or artifactually aged lymphocytes show few such cells with polyclonal T-cell populations and normal CD7/CD26 expression.
Neutrophils have abundant pink granular cytoplasm with lobes connected by thin filaments, not scant agranular cytoplasm.

65466.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓抹片出現一大團以藍色纖維狀細胞質細胞堆成的結節，幾乎沒有造血細胞；高倍可見細胞質如揉皺紙巾（crumpled tissue paper）、核小而偏位的高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell），符合骨髓高雪氏瘤（Gaucheroma）。
features: Low power: large cohesive aggregate composed almost entirely of histiocytes with blue fibrillary cytoplasm, with very few hematopoietic cells
Very large histiocytes with low N:C ratio and small, eccentric, round nuclei with condensed chromatin
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with striated, wrinkled 'crumpled tissue paper' texture (typical Gaucher cells, a)
Some Gaucher cells with less striated, more finely granular or vacuolated cytoplasm (less typical forms, b)
Scattered red cells and occasional small hematopoietic cells in the background
65466.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a large particle-like aggregate composed almost exclusively of large histiocytes with pale blue fibrillary cytoplasm, forming a pseudotumoral cluster with minimal residual hematopoiesis. At high power, the histiocytes have small eccentric nuclei and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with a striated, crumpled tissue paper appearance; some cells show less typical, more finely granular cytoplasm. No blasts or atypical epithelial cells are identified. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells forming a bone marrow Gaucheroma in a patient with known type 1 Gaucher disease.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (e.g., CML, myeloma, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look similar but occur in the setting of a separate neoplasm or infection with normal glucocerebrosidase activity; enzyme assay/GBA genotyping and the background marrow separate them.
Niemann-Pick cells have bubbly, uniformly vacuolated foamy cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules of ceroid rather than a wrinkled striated cytoplasm.
Carcinoma clumps are cohesive cells with high N:C ratio, nuclear atypia and nucleoli, unlike these bland small-nucleated histiocytes.

65082.recognize_zh: 一個濾泡內有兩個相鄰的淡染生發中心，被同一圈擴大且呈同心圓排列的套區小淋巴球包圍（twinning），這是 Castleman 病常見的濾泡改變。
features: Two adjacent pale germinal centers enclosed within a single shared mantle zone (twinning)
Germinal centers appear small to regressed with pale eosinophilic, histiocytoid/FDC-rich cells
Expanded mantle zone with small lymphocytes arranged in concentric layers
Small hyalinized vessels near and between the germinal centers
Interfollicular areas with increased small vessels; no atypical large cell sheets
65082.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a follicle containing two pale germinal centers that share a single expanded mantle zone (germinal center twinning). The mantle zone lymphocytes are arranged in concentric layers, and small vessels are present within and around the follicle, with increased interfollicular vascularity. No cytologically atypical population is seen in this field. The findings are consistent with Castleman disease-type morphology, which in the appropriate clinical and laboratory setting supports idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles may merge but have large polarized germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and thin mantles rather than regressed centers in concentric mantles.
Similar architecture, but LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zone define HHV-8 MCD.
FL follicles are back-to-back, lack mantle zones and polarization, and are BCL-2-positive and monoclonal.
IgG4-RD may show Castleman-like follicles but has many IgG4+ plasma cells (IgG4/IgG ratio >40%) with elevated serum IgG4.

64954.recognize_zh: A、B 張 H&E 顯示小至中型、細胞質少的藍色細胞呈片狀及索狀浸潤於纖維化間質中，C 到 H 的免疫染色顯示這些細胞表現 CD34、TdT、PAX5、CD19、CD79a 與 CD20，屬於前驅 B 淋巴母細胞，於睪丸切片中代表 B-ALL 睪丸復發。
features: Panel A (low power): diffuse infiltrate of small blue cells arranged in cords and streams separated by fibrotic stroma; seminiferous tubules not identifiable in this field
Panel B (high power): sheets of monotonous small-to-medium blasts with round to irregular nuclei, fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Panels C and H: cytoplasmic/membranous positivity for CD34 and CD20 in the infiltrate
Panels D-G: nuclear TdT and PAX5 positivity, and CD19/CD79a staining of the blasts
Immunostains show variable intensity; exact panel-marker assignment follows the figure legend
64954.describe_en: Testicular biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of small-to-medium blasts with scant cytoplasm, fine chromatin and round to irregular nuclei, arranged in cords and sheets within fibrotic stroma (A, B). Residual seminiferous tubules are not evident in these fields. By immunohistochemistry, the infiltrate expresses CD34, TdT, PAX5, CD19, CD79a and CD20 (C-H). This immature B-cell phenotype, in a patient with prior B-lymphoblastic leukemia and a normal bone marrow, is consistent with isolated testicular relapse of B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Testicular DLBCL occurs in older men with larger cells, vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and is TdT- and CD34-negative.
Seminoma cells have clear cytoplasm and large nucleoli with lymphocyte-rich septa and are OCT3/4 and SALL4 positive, CD45/PAX5 negative.
Myeloid sarcoma expresses MPO, CD117 or lysozyme and lacks PAX5/CD19 in most cases.
Inflammatory infiltrates are polymorphous with plasma cells and histiocytes and lack TdT/CD34-positive blasts.

64954.stain: H&E; IHC: CD34, TdT, PAX5, CD19, CD79a, CD20

64378.recognize_zh: 六格拼圖中的大細胞都有小而偏心的核與大量淡紫藍色、帶細條紋（皺紙樣）的細胞質，大小各異、有的單核有的成對，這些是不同型態的 Gaucher 細胞。
features: Composite of six fields showing large histiocytes of varying size and shape
Abundant pale lilac to blue-gray cytoplasm with fine fibrillary striations (crumpled paper)
Small eccentric round nuclei with coarse chromatin; paired cells in one panel
Cells markedly larger than surrounding erythroid and myeloid precursors
No uniform foamy vacuoles or discrete sea-blue granules
64378.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear, presented as a multi-panel composite, shows numerous large storage histiocytes varying in size and contour. Each has a small eccentric nucleus with coarse chromatin and abundant pale blue-gray to lilac cytoplasm with a striated, crumpled paper texture. Foamy vacuolation and discrete granules are not seen, and the surrounding hematopoietic cells show no overt dysplasia in these fields. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells in Gaucher disease, to be confirmed by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA1 testing.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look nearly identical but occur with CML, myeloma, thalassemia or mycobacterial infection and have normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have soap-bubble vacuolated cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules instead of diffuse striated cytoplasm.

64186.recognize_zh: 三顆成熟分葉嗜中性球的細胞質內，除了正常細顆粒外，還有多顆大小不一、明顯較粗大的紫紅至灰藍色顆粒；這種在成熟白血球中出現巨大顆粒的表現，是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的典型線索。
features: Three mature segmented neutrophils with normal nuclear lobation and clumped chromatin
Cytoplasm contains abnormally large, coarse, round granules of variable size (pink-purple to slate)
Giant granules scattered among finer normal-appearing granules
No toxic vacuolation, Döhle bodies, or blasts in the field
Background red cells largely normal with occasional crenated cells; a few platelets
64186.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mature segmented neutrophils containing multiple abnormally large, coarse cytoplasmic granules of variable size admixed with smaller granules. Nuclear segmentation is normal and there are no dysplastic features, blasts, or toxic changes in this field. Red cells show only occasional crenation artifact. Findings are consistent with the giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine-to-coarse dark primary granules distributed evenly throughout the cytoplasm, not a few discrete giant inclusions.
These occur in dysplastic granulocytes or blasts in a myeloid neoplasm, whereas CHS affects otherwise normal mature cells with albinism and immunodeficiency.
Alder-Reilly granules are uniformly dense and dark in all leukocytes rather than sparse giant granules.
Döhle-like inclusions are pale blue, elongated, peripheral cytoplasmic patches, and May-Hegglin has giant platelets, unlike round giant granules.

64122.recognize_zh: 這是 B 細胞 gate 後的流式細胞六格圖：CD19+ 細胞共同表現 CD5（A），CD20 偏弱、CD10 陰性（B），CD23 部分陽性（C），CD38 陰性（D），κ 輕鏈單株限制（E），CD200 陽性（F），為典型慢性淋巴球性白血病／小淋巴球淋巴瘤（CLL/SLL）免疫表型。
features: Gated B cells (CD19+) form a single tight population co-expressing CD5 (A)
CD20 dim with no CD10 expression (B)
CD23 positive on a substantial subset with a tail of brighter expression (C)
CD38 largely negative (D)
Light chain restriction: kappa expressed with lambda negative (E)
CD200 positive (dim-to-moderate) on the gated B cells (F)
64122.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the lymph node, gated on B cells, shows a monotypic B-cell population that co-expresses CD19 and CD5 and is CD10-negative with dim CD20. The population expresses CD23 and CD200, is CD38-negative, and shows kappa light chain restriction. This non-morphologic figure demonstrates a CD5+/CD23+/CD200+ monoclonal B-cell phenotype. Findings are consistent with involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MCL is typically CD5+ but CD23-negative, CD200-negative/dim with bright CD20 and surface light chain, and is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive with t(11;14).
MZL is usually CD5-negative and CD23-negative, although rare CD5+ cases require morphology and exclusion of CLL score markers.
FL is CD10-positive and CD5-negative with bright CD20.
LPL is usually CD5-negative, CD23-negative with a plasmacytic component and MYD88 L265P mutation.

64058.recognize_zh: 雙重免疫染色中，大型 Reed-Sternberg／Hodgkin 細胞有清楚的棕色膜狀 PD-L1 染色，核內僅淡粉紅色弱 PAX5；周圍小 B 細胞核呈鮮紅色強 PAX5，背景組織球也有棕色 PD-L1，這種「大細胞 PAX5 弱陽性」對比是古典何杰金淋巴瘤的特徵。
features: Large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with large vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, some binucleate
Membranous and cytoplasmic brown (DAB) PD-L1 staining outlining the large neoplastic cells
Weak, pale pink-red nuclear PAX5 in the large cells
Scattered small background B cells with strong, bright red nuclear PAX5 serving as internal contrast
Diffuse brown PD-L1 staining of background histiocytes in a mixed inflammatory milieu; PAX5-negative small T cells with blue nuclei
64058.describe_en: Dual immunohistochemistry (PD-L1 in brown, PAX5 in red) shows scattered large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, including binucleate forms, in a background of small lymphocytes and histiocytes. The large cells display membranous PD-L1 staining and weak nuclear PAX5, in contrast to strong nuclear PAX5 in the admixed small reactive B cells. Background histiocytes are moderately to strongly PD-L1 positive, serving as an internal control, and small T cells are PAX5 negative. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma with PD-L1 expression by Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, reflecting the 9p24.1 amplification typical of this entity.

ddx.vs: LP cells show strong nuclear PAX5 with CD20/OCT2/BOB1 positivity and are CD30/CD15 negative, rather than weak PAX5.
The large cells have strong PAX5 and CD20 expression in a T-cell and histiocyte-rich background without CD30/CD15.
ALCL cells are PAX5-negative with a T-cell or null phenotype and uniformly strong CD30 in sheets, and ALK-positive cases lack PD-L1 amplification-driven staining.
PMBL also expresses PD-L1 but its sheets of large cells show strong PAX5/CD20 and CD23 positivity.

63994.recognize_zh: 淋巴結被瀰漫性、中型至略大的淋巴細胞取代，其間散在許多淡染、含吞噬碎屑的易染體巨噬細胞（tingible-body macrophages，箭頭）形成星空樣（starry sky）外觀，並有凋亡小體；形態像 Burkitt 淋巴瘤，但無 MYC 重組而有 11q 異常，診斷為具 11q 異常的 Burkitt 樣淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of intermediate to large lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm
Round to irregular, somewhat squared-off nuclei with fine to dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Numerous tingible-body macrophages with pale cytoplasm containing apoptotic debris (arrowhead), producing a starry-sky pattern
Frequent apoptotic bodies; slightly more nuclear pleomorphism than classic Burkitt lymphoma
Small scattered vessels within the diffuse infiltrate
63994.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show diffuse effacement of the architecture by sheets of intermediate to large lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. Numerous tingible-body macrophages containing apoptotic debris (arrowhead) impart a starry-sky appearance, and apoptotic bodies are frequent. Cytologically, the cells show slightly more pleomorphism than typical Burkitt lymphoma. In conjunction with a CD10+/BCL6+/BCL2- germinal center phenotype, absence of MYC rearrangement, and 11q gain/loss pattern on FISH, findings are consistent with Burkitt-like lymphoma with 11q aberration (high-grade B-cell lymphoma with 11q aberration).

ddx.vs: Burkitt lymphoma is morphologically similar but more monotonous and carries an IG::MYC rearrangement with Ki-67 near 100%, whereas 11q aberration lacks MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma shows MYC plus BCL2 rearrangements on FISH and is usually BCL2 positive, unlike this BCL2-negative case without rearrangements.
DLBCL cells are generally larger with vesicular chromatin and more cytoplasm, a less prominent starry-sky pattern, and a lower proliferation index.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma has finely stippled blastic chromatin and is TdT/CD34 positive, with a less conspicuous starry-sky pattern.

63930.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指細胞含五個大小相近、染色質濃縮的圓形核，細胞質呈均勻灰藍色（多染性紅血球母細胞質地）且無顆粒，即為多核（五核）紅血球母細胞，是紅系發育異常（dyserythropoiesis）的線索。
features: Erythroblast (arrow) containing five separate round nuclei of similar size
Nuclei have condensed, clumped chromatin without nucleoli, consistent with polychromatophilic-stage maturation
Agranular gray-blue cytoplasm with a smooth round cell outline
Adjacent granulocytes (band and segmented forms) with preserved granulation
Background red cells and scattered platelets; a smudged pink granular cell fragment is present
63930.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered maturing granulocytes and red cells. The arrowed cell is an erythroblast with agranular gray-blue cytoplasm containing five discrete, round nuclei with condensed chromatin, representing a multinucleated (pentanucleated) erythroid precursor. Adjacent granulocytes show preserved granulation in this field. Findings indicate dyserythropoiesis; in the clinical context, they are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome, though multinuclearity alone is not specific and must be interpreted with the proportion of dysplastic erythroid cells and cytogenetics.

ddx.dx: Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II or III
ddx.vs: CDA shows multinucleated erythroblasts (bi-nucleated in type II, giant multinucleated in type III) in a young patient without other lineage dysplasia or clonal cytogenetics.
Megaloblastic anemia gives nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin and giant metamyelocytes, and it corrects with B12 or folate.
Osteoclasts have many separate nuclei with abundant granular cytoplasm and megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei in far larger cells, unlike this small agranular erythroblast.
Toxic dyserythropoiesis can look identical, so exposure history and reversibility after withdrawal separate it from clonal MDS.

63866.recognize_zh: 視野中多數淋巴球的核深度分葉成三葉草或花瓣狀（flower cells），染色質濃縮、細胞質極少，數量眾多且形態一致，這是成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（ATLL）的經典周邊血表現。
features: Numerous medium-sized lymphocytes with deeply lobulated, clover-leaf or flower-shaped nuclei
Condensed, coarsely clumped chromatin without visible nucleoli
Scant, pale, agranular cytoplasm
Occasional small lymphocytes with round nuclei for size comparison
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking and scattered platelets
63866.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked lymphocytosis composed of medium-sized lymphoid cells with multilobated, clover-leaf (flower-shaped) nuclei, condensed chromatin, absent nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. Occasional small mature lymphocytes are present for comparison. No blasts or granular lymphocytes are seen. Flow cytometry (typically CD4+, CD25+, CD7-) and HTLV-1 serology are needed for confirmation. Findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma (flower cells).

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform, finely grooved nuclei rather than deep petal-like lobation, and are HTLV-1-negative and usually CD25-negative/dim.
Neutrophils have abundant cytoplasm with specific granules and lobes joined by thin chromatin strands, not scant agranular cytoplasm around clustered lobes.
T-PLL cells have a visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs with round or irregular nuclei, and express TCL1.
Reactive cells are heterogeneous with more abundant basophilic cytoplasm, while flower cells here are numerous and monomorphic.

63802.recognize_zh: CD20 染色只呈弱而斑駁的顆粒狀陽性，許多大型多葉核或怪異核的腫瘤細胞近乎陰性，這種 CD20 表現不一致是灰區淋巴瘤介於 DLBCL 與典型霍奇金淋巴瘤之間的線索。
features: Weak, patchy, granular cytoplasmic/membranous CD20 staining in a subset of cells
Several large pleomorphic and multilobated tumor cells appear largely negative
Positive signal distributed irregularly rather than as crisp uniform membranes
Dense population of medium-to-large cells with vesicular nuclei
No strong diffuse sheet-like CD20 positivity
63802.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 shows weak and heterogeneous granular staining in a subset of cells, while many large pleomorphic and multilobated tumor cells are negative or only faintly positive. Strong, uniform membranous positivity across sheets of cells is not seen. This variable CD20 expression, in the context of CD15 and CD30 positivity in the same large cells, supports B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between DLBCL and classic Hodgkin lymphoma (mediastinal gray zone lymphoma); distinguishing positive small reactive B cells from tumor cells at this resolution is limited.

ddx.vs: Tumor cells show strong and uniform membranous CD20 and CD79a with sheet-like growth, rather than weak patchy staining.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are usually CD20 negative or only weak in a minority, with dim PAX5 and a background of reactive cells.
Scattered large cells are strongly CD20 positive and CD15/CD30 negative, amid abundant T cells and histiocytes.
Large cells are CD20 and PAX5 negative with T-cell antigen or ALK expression.

63738.recognize_zh: 低倍血液抹片可見紅血球聚成大小不一、形狀不規則的團塊（agglutination），而不是成串的錢串狀（rouleaux）；團塊分布於整張片子，提示冷凝集素造成的紅血球凝集。
features: Low-power smear with red cells forming irregular, variably sized three-dimensional clumps
Clumps have irregular grape-like borders rather than linear stacked chains
Agglutinates distributed throughout the smear with intervening single red cells
Scattered leukocytes visible but not assessable at this magnification
63738.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows extensive red blood cell agglutination, with erythrocytes forming irregular, variably sized clumps distributed throughout the field and interspersed with single cells. The aggregates are irregular rather than linear coin-stack chains, distinguishing them from rouleaux. Leukocyte and red cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with red cell agglutination due to a cold agglutinin; correlation with warming the sample to 37°C, direct antiglobulin test (C3d positive) and cold agglutinin titer is recommended. Agglutination may spuriously lower RBC count and elevate MCV and MCHC.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear stacks of coins and disperse with saline dilution, whereas agglutinates are irregular clumps that disperse with warming.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes and IgG-positive DAT with little agglutination on the smear.
Drying artifact produces overlapping cells in the thick part of the smear only, not discrete clumps with clear spaces in the monolayer.
PCH (Donath-Landsteiner IgG) causes hemolysis and erythrophagocytosis, usually without prominent agglutination.

63674.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抽吸片，骨髓小粒周圍與拖尾區布滿各階段造血細胞，夾雜脂肪空泡，看得出細胞量充足、三系造血（trilineage hematopoiesis）存在；此倍率無法細看發育異常。
features: Cellular aspirate smear with abundant hematopoietic cells spread around marrow particles
Admixed fat vacuoles of variable size within and around particles
Mixed population of granulocytic precursors, erythroid precursors and occasional megakaryocytes
No cohesive clusters of non-hematopoietic cells or sheets of uniform blasts at this power
Low magnification precludes evaluation of dysplasia or blast percentage
63674.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with numerous hematopoietic cells dispersed around particles containing fat vacuoles. A heterogeneous mixture of maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements with occasional megakaryocytes is seen, indicating trilineage hematopoiesis. No tumor clusters or monotonous blast sheets are evident at this magnification. Assessment of dysplasia (including megakaryocyte lobation) and blast count requires higher-power examination.

ddx.vs: Hemodilute or hypocellular aspirates show sparse cells amid predominantly peripheral blood elements and fat, unlike this densely cellular smear.
Acute leukemia replaces the heterogeneous maturing population with a monotonous sheet of blasts, which is not apparent here.

63482.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中多顆中型母細胞，染色質細緻、細胞質中等量淡藍無顆粒，細胞核一側有淡色凹陷，使核呈杯狀（cup-like / fish-mouth nuclei），這是 NPM1 突變 AML 常見的形態線索。
features: Numerous medium-to-large blasts with moderate N:C ratio
Cup-shaped nuclei with a pale invagination along one side (cuplike/fish-mouth appearance)
Fine, open chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale blue, largely agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods visible
Background normocytic red cells with occasional small lymphocyte/nRBC; platelets reduced
63482.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium-to-large blasts with fine open chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm. Many blasts have cup-shaped nuclei with a pale nuclear invagination occupying part of the nucleus, and no Auer rods are identified in this field. Platelets appear decreased and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cuplike blast morphology, a pattern associated with NPM1 mutation and often FLT3-ITD; the CD34-negative, HLA-DR-negative immunophenotype and molecular results support AML with NPM1 mutation.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed or butterfly-shaped nuclei with fine granules and Auer rod bundles, and is also CD34-/HLA-DR-, so PML::RARA testing is essential.
Monoblasts and promonocytes have abundant gray-blue, sometimes vacuolated cytoplasm with folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase positive with CD14/CD64.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and are MPO negative with TdT and B- or T-lineage antigens, whereas these blasts express cMPO.
Cuplike nuclei are not specific, so the diagnosis rests on NPM1 mutation status and the absence of defining MDS-related cytogenetic or molecular lesions.

63354.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見明顯增加的小型淋巴球，數顆淋巴球邊緣帶有圓形透明的球狀包涵體，另有塗抹細胞，符合 CLL 伴細胞質包涵體。
features: Increased small mature lymphocytes with dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Many lymphocytes with a single round, clear globular inclusion at the cell edge, some indenting the nucleus
Occasional smudge cells
One larger lymphoid cell with more open chromatin
Normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
63354.describe_en: Low-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows an absolute lymphocytosis of small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin. Numerous lymphocytes contain round, clear globular cytoplasmic inclusions that are appreciable even at this magnification, and smudge cells are present. Red cells show no significant morphologic abnormality. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with lymphocyte cytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant basophilic cytoplasm and lack smudge cells and uniform globular inclusions.
Storage diseases produce multiple fine vacuoles in lymphocytes of children without a clonal lymphocytosis.
LPL shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes with PAS-positive immunoglobulin inclusions and an IgM paraprotein.

63290.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 骨髓切片中，箭頭所指是一顆體積小、只有單一圓形核與粉紅色胞質的小型單核巨核細胞（hypolobated/mononuclear megakaryocyte），背景有許多核染色質開放、帶核仁的芽細胞，提示伴隨異生變化的 AML。
features: Small megakaryocyte (arrow) with a single round, non-lobated nucleus and moderate pink granular cytoplasm, only slightly larger than surrounding cells
Numerous medium to large immature cells with oval nuclei, vesicular chromatin and small visible nucleoli
Scattered small cells with dense round nuclei consistent with late erythroid precursors or lymphocytes
Intervening adipocytes and extravasated red cells
63290.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, high power) shows a cellular marrow containing many medium to large immature cells with oval nuclei, vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with scattered small dense erythroid precursors. The arrow highlights a small megakaryocyte with a single round, non-lobated nucleus, consistent with a dysplastic mononuclear (hypolobated) megakaryocyte. Normal maturing myeloid elements are reduced in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with dysplastic megakaryocytes, supporting myelodysplasia-related changes in the appropriate cytogenetic and clinical context.

ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes of this size are uncommon and usually already show nuclear lobation, while megakaryoblasts lack abundant granular cytoplasm; CD61/CD42b IHC helps confirm lineage.
MPN megakaryocytes are typically large with hyperlobated or cloud-like nuclei and clustering, without a blast excess.
Histiocytes have pale vacuolated cytoplasm and plasma cells have eccentric clock-face nuclei with a hof, whereas megakaryocytic cytoplasm is dense, pink and granular.

63098.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片背景中散布大量 2–4 μm 的卵圓形小體，每個都有一個紫紅色核與旁邊一個小棒狀動基體（kinetoplast），多數位於細胞外；這些是 Leishmania 無鞭毛體（LD bodies）。
features: Numerous small (about 2-4 um) oval organisms scattered extracellularly between marrow cells
Each organism with a round purple nucleus and a small, rod-shaped, darker kinetoplast
Pale to clear organism cytoplasm; some forms clustered as if released from ruptured macrophages
Background of erythroid precursors, myeloid precursors and lymphocytes
No intraerythrocytic parasites; organisms distinct from platelets by nucleus-kinetoplast pair
63098.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear under oil immersion shows numerous small oval amastigotes, predominantly extracellular in this field, each with a nucleus and an adjacent rod-shaped kinetoplast. The organisms are scattered among erythroid and myeloid precursors and lymphocytes, likely released from disrupted macrophages. Findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis (Leishman-Donovan bodies).

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are similar in size and intracellular but have a single eccentric nucleus with a clear halo and lack a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic with a central nucleus and no kinetoplast.
Platelets lack the organized nucleus plus bar-shaped kinetoplast arrangement of amastigotes.
Morphologically identical in tissue, so separation relies on geography, clinical setting, blood trypomastigotes or PCR.

63034.recognize_zh: E-cadherin 染色下幾個特別大的細胞（明顯大於周圍造血細胞）細胞膜與細胞質呈棕色陽性，核大且染色質淡、呈毛玻璃樣，是被 Parvovirus B19 感染的巨大前紅血球母細胞。
features: Scattered giant cells (several times the size of surrounding hematopoietic cells) with strong membranous and cytoplasmic E-cadherin positivity
Large round nuclei with pale, glassy (ground-glass) chromatin and marginated chromatin rim
Smaller E-cadherin-positive erythroid precursors scattered nearby
Background hematopoietic and lymphoid cells negative, with adipocytes
Scale bar 20 um confirms cell diameters well above normal pronormoblast size
63034.describe_en: E-cadherin immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow core biopsy highlights scattered giant erythroid precursors with membranous and cytoplasmic positivity. These cells have large round nuclei with pale ground-glass chromatin and peripheral chromatin margination, consistent with viral cytopathic effect. Only a few smaller E-cadherin-positive erythroid precursors are present, suggesting reduced erythropoiesis, while the remaining hematopoietic cells are negative. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection of erythroid precursors; confirmation by parvovirus IHC or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic and dysplastic erythroid precursors are enlarged but show a full maturation spectrum without glassy intranuclear inclusions and are parvovirus negative.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of E-cadherin-positive proerythroblasts with high proliferation and p53 overexpression, rather than scattered isolated giant cells.
Megakaryocytes are CD61/CD42b positive with lobulated dense nuclei and E-cadherin negative.
Carcinoma cells are also E-cadherin positive but form cohesive clusters that are keratin positive and lack erythroid markers.

62970.recognize_zh: 稀釋的骨髓抹片中，大部分是紅血球與少數散在的造血細胞，中央有一小團細胞核深染、互相重疊擠壓、胞質合成一片的黏聚性細胞群（cohesive cluster），與周圍散在的造血細胞明顯不同，提示轉移性癌細胞（此例為乳癌）。
features: Small cohesive cluster of overlapping cells with nuclear molding and shared cytoplasm, distinct from hematopoietic cells
Cluster nuclei are round, hyperchromatic and larger than adjacent lymphocytes
Moderate pale to lightly basophilic cytoplasm without granules
Markedly hemodilute smear with sparse scattered hematopoietic cells
Only a single tumor cluster visible at this low power; cytologic detail limited
62970.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa, low power) is markedly hemodilute with sparse hematopoietic elements. A small cohesive cluster of nonhematopoietic-appearing cells with overlapping, hyperchromatic round nuclei, nuclear molding and ill-defined shared cytoplasm is present centrally. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification, and the aspirate may underrepresent tumor burden. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, compatible with the reported ER/PR-positive metastatic breast cancer; trephine biopsy with cytokeratin and GATA3 immunostains is recommended to assess extent.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts form loose clusters of larger comet-shaped cells with eccentric nuclei and a pale zone away from the nucleus, without nuclear molding or overlap.
A megakaryocyte has a single lobulated nucleus with abundant granular cytoplasm and platelet budding rather than several molded separate nuclei.
Hematolymphoid cells are discohesive with visible cell borders and are CD45-positive, whereas carcinoma cells are cohesive and keratin-positive.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumor (neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These occur mainly in children and form rosettes or syncytia with scant cytoplasm, and are keratin-negative with specific markers (PHOX2B, myogenin).

62906.recognize_zh: 視野中兩個顆粒性白血球：左上細胞整個細胞質被深紫黑色粗顆粒填滿，右下細胞核呈腎形至帶狀，黑色顆粒團偏聚在細胞一側；在碘造影劑注射後的血片中，這類黑色顆粒可出現在嗜中性球與較不成熟的骨髓系細胞。
features: Upper-left granulocyte with cytoplasm densely packed by coarse dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus
Lower-right granulocyte with an indented to band-shaped nucleus and a focal aggregate of dark granules
Pale pink cytoplasm with finer granules in the less involved cell
Background red cells with numerous echinocytes and scattered platelets
62906.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two granulocytes containing coarse, dark purple-black cytoplasmic granular material. In the upper-left cell the material densely fills the cytoplasm and obscures the nucleus, whereas the lower-right cell, with an indented to band-form nucleus, shows a focal aggregate of dark granules within otherwise pale granular cytoplasm. The red cells show numerous echinocytes. The densely granulated cell could be mistaken for a basophil; with the history of sampling after iodinated contrast and similar material in bands and immature granulocytes, findings are consistent with pigment in neutrophils and myeloid precursors.

ddx.vs: A basophil has uniformly sized purple-black granules and would not share the same granular clumps with adjacent bands and metamyelocytes.
Toxic granules are finer and diffusely distributed rather than coarse black aggregates.
Large dark granules are present in all granulocytes as an inherited trait, independent of contrast exposure or sepsis.

62842.recognize_zh: H&E 骨髓切片中，緊貼骨小樑的旁小樑區（paratrabecular zone）有厚層、胞質粉紅淡染、核圓至豆形的前骨髓細胞與骨髓細胞（promyelocyte–myelocyte），往中央逐漸轉為較小、深染的成熟顆粒球，顯示顆粒球系增生但成熟順序保留；此視野看不到明顯的漿細胞群。
features: Two H&E fields (low and higher power) of hypercellular marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula
Broad paratrabecular band of immature granulocytes with round-to-oval vesicular nuclei and pale eosinophilic granular cytoplasm (promyelocytes/myelocytes)
Gradient of maturation toward the intertrabecular center with smaller, darker, segmented forms
Scattered erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei; rare small fat vacuole
No sheets of blasts and no conspicuous plasma cell clusters in these fields
62842.describe_en: H&E sections of the bone marrow trephine show a hypercellular marrow with a widened paratrabecular zone composed of promyelocytes and myelocytes with vesicular nuclei and pale granular cytoplasm. Toward the central intertrabecular space there is orderly progression to metamyelocytes and segmented neutrophils, indicating granulocytic hyperplasia with preserved maturation. Scattered erythroid precursors are present, and no blast sheets or discrete plasma cell aggregates are evident in these fields. These myeloid changes accompany the plasma cell myeloma in this case, and immunohistochemistry is needed to demonstrate the plasma cell infiltrate.

ddx.vs: APL shows sheets of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with loss of maturation and PML::RARA, whereas here promyelocytes are confined to the paratrabecular layer with orderly maturation.
CML shows a markedly thickened paratrabecular cuff with small hypolobated megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1, which would need to be excluded by genetics.

ddx.dx: Reactive granulocytic hyperplasia or G-CSF effect
ddx.vs: Reactive left-shifted hyperplasia looks identical morphologically and is separated clinically and by the absence of a clonal CD138-positive plasma cell population.

ddx.dx: Abnormal localization of immature precursors (ALIP) in MDS
ddx.vs: ALIP shows clusters of immature myeloid cells in the central intertrabecular space away from trabeculae, the reverse of the paratrabecular location seen here.

62778.recognize_zh: 抹片與腹水細胞離心片中大量中型淋巴細胞，核型略不規則、可見明顯單一核仁（箭頭），胞質嗜鹼性並有小泡狀突起；流式顯示 CD4+ 並表現胞質 TCL1，核型分析有染色體異常（箭頭），符合 T 細胞前淋巴球白血病以腹水表現。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei and moderately condensed chromatin
Visible single nucleolus in many cells (arrow, cytospin)
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs or protrusions
Immunocytochemistry shows diffuse cytoplasmic/membranous positivity in the neoplastic cells
Flow cytometry: CD4-positive population co-expressing cytoplasmic TCL1; karyotype with structural abnormalities (arrows)
62778.describe_en: Smears show numerous medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm with occasional cytoplasmic blebs. On the ascitic fluid cytospin, many cells display a distinct single nucleolus (arrow). Immunocytochemistry diffusely labels the neoplastic cells, and flow cytometry shows a CD4-positive population with bright cytoplasmic TCL1 expression. The karyotype shows structural chromosomal abnormalities (arrows), which cannot be fully characterized at this resolution. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia with serous effusion involvement; FISH for TCL1A (14q32) or MTCP1 rearrangement is recommended.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells have polylobated flower-shaped nuclei, are CD25-positive, and occur in HTLV-1 carriers, while T-PLL cells are TCL1-positive with a single prominent nucleolus.
Sezary cells show cerebriform convoluted nuclei without prominent nucleoli, often lose CD7, and lack TCL1 overexpression.

ddx.dx: B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia or CLL with prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: B-cell prolymphocytes look similar but are CD19/CD20-positive with light chain restriction rather than CD4+ T cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphocytes in a lymphocytic effusion
ddx.vs: Reactive effusion lymphocytes are small mature cells without nucleoli and show normal polyclonal T-cell phenotype without TCL1 overexpression.

62714.recognize_zh: 活細胞的 CD36 對 CD64 流式圖：大量事件 CD36 陰性、CD64 陰性到中度（沿垂直方向延伸），另有一條對角線族群 CD36 與 CD64 同時由弱到強表現直至 10⁵，藍紅兩色族群都分布其中，提示部分原始細胞帶有單核球樣抗原表現，需搭配 CD14、CD11c、溶菌酶等判斷是否為單核球分化。
features: Live-gated events; CD36-FITC (x-axis) versus CD64-PE (y-axis)
Large population CD36 negative to dim with CD64 negative, extending vertically to moderate CD64 (about 10^4)
Diagonal population co-expressing CD36 and CD64 with increasing intensity up to about 10^5 for both
Blue and red color-coded populations intermixed throughout both regions, without clear separation by these two markers
Small cluster of brightest CD36/CD64 events at the upper right, consistent with residual monocytes
62714.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of live events displays CD36 versus CD64. A large population is CD36 negative to dim with CD64 ranging from negative to moderate, and a second diagonal population co-expresses CD36 and CD64 up to bright levels, with a small cluster of brightest events likely representing residual monocytes. Both color-coded blast populations are distributed within these regions. CD64 and CD36 expression may indicate monocytic differentiation, but CD64 is also seen on myeloblasts and CD36 on erythroid/megakaryocytic cells, so monocytic lineage requires at least two of NSE, CD11c, CD14, CD64 or lysozyme. In context, the findings contribute to the myeloid lineage evaluation in mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.vs: Shows a dominant CD64-bright/CD36-bright population with CD14, CD11b, CD4 and HLA-DR and lacks B-lineage markers.
CD36 is expressed without CD64, together with CD71/CD235a or CD41/CD61.
Mature monocytes are CD45 bright with intermediate side scatter and CD14 positive, whereas this sample has only 0.06% monocytes by CD45/SS.

62522.recognize_zh: 左側為大片淡染、細顆粒狀的無細胞壞死區，右側交界處有一層細長核、朝壞死排列的上皮樣組織球，再外為含小血管與紅血球的纖維組織；壞死區與柵欄狀組織球層清楚分界，符合壞死性肉芽腫。
features: Extensive acellular, pale, finely granular necrosis occupying half of the field
Band of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated nuclei palisading along the necrotic edge
Scattered karyorrhectic nuclear fragments at the interface
Outer fibrous tissue with small vessels, erythrocytes and scattered lymphocytes
62522.describe_en: Intermediate-power H&E shows extensive acellular, pale, finely granular necrosis sharply bordered by a band of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated nuclei palisading along its edge, with scattered karyorrhectic debris at the interface. Beyond the histiocytic layer there is fibrous tissue containing small vessels, erythrocytes and scattered lymphocytes. No giant cells, atypical cells or organisms are seen. Findings are consistent with a necrotizing granuloma, compatible with cat scratch disease; stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi, and Bartonella studies, are recommended.

ddx.vs: Caseating granulomas typically contain Langhans giant cells and acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
GMS/PAS stains show fungal organisms within the necrotic center.
Viable atypical lymphoid cells at the edge of necrosis and a monoclonal immunophenotype favor lymphoma over granulomatous inflammation.

62458.recognize_zh: 淋巴球 gate 的 CD8 對 CD4 流式圖：絕大多數細胞位於 CD8 陰性、CD4 dim 的藍色大族群，綠色正常 CD4 亮度的 T 細胞較少，左上 CD8 陽性 T 細胞只剩一小群，CD4:CD8 比明顯升高並有 CD4 表現減弱，支持 Sézary 細胞血液侵犯。
features: Dot plot of CD8-ECD versus CD4-FITC gated on lymphocytes (60.35% of total events)
Dominant blue population that is CD8-negative with dim, spread-out CD4 expression
Discrete green CD4-positive CD8-negative population at normal CD4 intensity (residual normal CD4 T cells)
Small CD8-bright CD4-negative T-cell cluster in the upper left, markedly reduced relative to CD4 cells
Grey CD4-negative CD8-dim to negative events (NK and B cells); non-morphologic figure
62458.describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of CD8 versus CD4 on gated lymphocytes shows a markedly skewed distribution, with a large CD8-negative population expressing dim CD4 and a smaller discrete population of normal-intensity CD4-positive T cells. CD8-positive T cells form only a minor cluster, indicating a markedly elevated CD4:CD8 ratio. The dim CD4 intensity on the expanded population is an aberrant feature. These findings, in combination with CD7 and CD26 loss, support peripheral blood involvement by Sezary cells in mycosis fungoides/Sezary syndrome.

ddx.dx: Reactive CD4 lymphocytosis or inflammatory erythroderma
ddx.vs: Benign erythroderma may raise the CD4:CD8 ratio but lacks dim CD4 expression and substantial CD7/CD26-negative populations.
T-LGL expands CD8-positive cells, the opposite of this CD8-depleted pattern.

ddx.dx: Monocyte contamination of the lymphocyte gate
ddx.vs: Monocytes are CD4 dim but also CD14/CD64 positive with higher side scatter and are CD3 negative.

62394.recognize_zh: IgG4 免疫染色中大量深棕色陽性漿細胞主要聚集在多個生發中心內，濾泡間區也有散在陽性細胞；高密度的 IgG4 陽性漿細胞（需搭配 IgG 計算 IgG4/IgG 比例 >40% 且每高倍視野 >100 個）支持 IgG4 相關淋巴結病變（IgG4-related lymphadenopathy）。
features: Numerous IgG4-positive plasma cells with strong cytoplasmic staining
Positive cells concentrated within germinal centers of multiple reactive follicles
Scattered IgG4-positive cells in interfollicular areas
Negative mantle zones outlining follicles
Preserved follicular architecture
62394.describe_en: IgG4 immunostain of the lymph node shows numerous strongly positive plasma cells, predominantly concentrated within the germinal centers of multiple reactive follicles, with additional scattered positive cells in the interfollicular regions. Mantle zones are negative, and nodal architecture is preserved. The density of IgG4-positive cells appears well above 100 per high-power field within follicles. When correlated with an IgG stain showing an IgG4/IgG ratio greater than 40%, the findings are suggestive of IgG4-related lymphadenopathy, which must be interpreted together with clinical and serologic findings.

ddx.vs: MCD can have increased IgG4+ cells but shows sheets of interfollicular plasma cells, systemic inflammation with high IL-6/CRP, and a lower IgG4/IgG ratio pattern.
Nonspecific reactive nodes may contain IgG4+ cells, but the IgG4/IgG ratio and absolute counts usually fall below diagnostic thresholds.
Marginal zone or lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma shows light chain restricted plasma cells, whereas IgG4-related plasma cells are polytypic.

62330.recognize_zh: 左圖骨髓抹片中一團黏聚成群的圓形腫瘤細胞，核深染、細胞質極少、彼此擠壓（nuclear molding），與周圍分散的正常造血細胞明顯不同；右圖同類細胞團在抹片上做 synaptophysin 染色呈顆粒狀棕色陽性，支持神經母細胞瘤轉移。
features: Cohesive cluster of small to medium round cells with high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm (left panel)
Hyperchromatic round nuclei with finely granular chromatin and nuclear molding
Cluster embedded in pale amorphous/fibrillary material, distinct from scattered normal hematopoietic cells and neutrophils
Granular brown cytoplasmic and intercellular synaptophysin staining of the cluster on the smear (right panel)
Background single hematopoietic cells are synaptophysin-negative (blue)
62330.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (left panel) shows a cohesive cluster of small to medium round cells with scant cytoplasm, hyperchromatic nuclei with finely granular chromatin and nuclear molding, set apart from the background of dispersed normal hematopoietic cells including neutrophils. Synaptophysin immunocytochemistry performed on an aspirate smear (right panel) shows granular brown staining of a similar cohesive cluster, while background hematopoietic cells are negative. The findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma involving the bone marrow aspirate. Because the concurrent biopsies were negative, the result reflects focal involvement and highlights the complementary value of aspirate smears.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts and hematogones are discohesive single cells without molding and are synaptophysin-negative, TdT/CD34/CD19-positive by flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Clusters of normal marrow elements (osteoblasts or erythroid islands)
ddx.vs: Osteoblasts have abundant eccentric cytoplasm with a perinuclear clear zone and erythroid islands center on a macrophage, neither showing molding or synaptophysin positivity.

ddx.dx: Other small round blue cell tumors (Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma is CD99/NKX2.2-positive and rhabdomyosarcoma is desmin/myogenin-positive, whereas neuroblastoma expresses synaptophysin/PHOX2B and lacks CD99 membrane staining.
Crushed or clumped hematopoietic cells retain mixed cell types and smeared chromatin rather than a monotonous synaptophysin-positive cohesive cluster.

62202.recognize_zh: 抹片中大量小到中型淋巴球，染色質呈塊狀、細胞質稀少，其中夾雜少數體積較大、細胞質較多且核染色質較疏鬆的前淋巴球（prolymphocytes），並有破碎的塗抹細胞（smudge cell），符合 CLL 伴前淋巴球增加。
features: Numerous small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed clumped chromatin, and scant pale-blue cytoplasm
Admixed larger cells with moderately condensed chromatin and slightly more cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes
Occasional nuclear notching; nucleoli inconspicuous in most cells
Scattered platelet clumps; a granulated cell (likely basophil) and a segmented neutrophil at the bottom
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis
62202.describe_en: The smear shows a marked predominance of small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei, clumped chromatin, and scant cytoplasm, admixed with a subset of larger cells with less condensed chromatin and more abundant cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes. Occasional nuclear notches are present, while a neutrophil and a granulated (likely basophil) cell represent residual myeloid elements. Platelet clumps are noted in the background. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with increased prolymphocytes, supported by the CD5+/CD23+/FMC7-negative immunophenotype in this case.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells often have more irregular, cleaved nuclei and are CD23-negative/FMC7-positive with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression, whereas CLL is CD23-positive and cyclin D1-negative.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: B-PLL shows >55% prolymphocytes with prominent central nucleoli and is typically CD5-weak/negative, CD23-negative and FMC7-bright, unlike this predominantly small-cell CD5+/CD23+ population.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm and no smudge cells, and flow cytometry shows polytypic B cells without CD5 co-expression.

62138.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片下方有一群鬆散黏聚的中型異常細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、胞質少而淡藍，細胞大小明顯大於旁邊的小淋巴球，提示轉移性小圓細胞腫瘤（肺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤）。
features: Loosely cohesive group of medium-sized atypical cells, about 2–3 times the size of adjacent small lymphocytes
Round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin and indistinct nucleoli
Scant pale blue wispy cytoplasm with poorly defined borders
Occasional single atypical cells separate from the cluster
Hemodilute background with red cells showing refractile drying artifact
62138.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute background with a loosely cohesive group of medium-sized atypical cells in the lower field and a few similar single cells nearby. The cells have round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin, indistinct nucleoli, and scant pale basophilic cytoplasm with ill-defined borders. Adjacent small lymphocytes provide a size comparison, and dot-like red cell inclusions are consistent with artifact. The clustering suggests a metastatic small round cell tumor, consistent in this context with alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma; immunohistochemistry on the trephine biopsy is needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are evenly dispersed without cohesive groups and are identified by flow cytometry, whereas rhabdomyosarcoma is CD45-negative and myogenin-positive.
Neuroblastoma forms rosettes with pink fibrillary neuropil and is PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive.
Clumped marrow particles contain a mixed population of maturing myeloid and erythroid cells, unlike a monotonous group of atypical cells.
Ewing sarcoma shows membranous CD99 with NKX2.2 and EWSR1 rearrangement rather than desmin/myogenin expression.

62074.recognize_zh: 抹片中央有一大團緊密黏聚、細胞邊界不清且互相重疊的細胞團塊（cohesive cluster），體積遠大於周圍零散的造血細胞，這種三度空間的黏聚團塊提示骨髓轉移性腫瘤。
features: Large, three-dimensional cohesive cluster of tightly overlapping cells with indistinct cell borders
Crowded nuclei obscured by cluster thickness; individual nuclear detail and nucleoli not assessable
Deeply basophilic, frothy/ragged cytoplasm at the cluster periphery
Few scattered detached hematopoietic cells around the cluster, including granulocytic precursors
Background of thick, poorly spread blood/marrow material with smudged areas
62074.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large, dense, three-dimensional cohesive cluster of overlapping cells that is distinctly foreign to the normal hematopoietic population. Cell borders are indistinct and the thickness of the aggregate precludes assessment of individual nuclear and nucleolar features at this magnification. Only a few scattered hematopoietic cells are present in this field; overall marrow cellularity cannot be reliably judged from a single aspirate field and should be correlated with the trephine biopsy. Findings are suggestive of metastatic non-hematopoietic neoplasm; immunohistochemistry on the core or clot section is recommended for lineage determination.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are single large cells with lobulated nuclei and granular pink cytoplasm, whereas this aggregate is composed of many discrete overlapping cells forming a cohesive sheet.
Marrow particles contain a heterogeneous mixture of maturing hematopoietic cells, fat vacuoles and stroma rather than a monotonous tightly cohesive cell ball.
Osteoblasts show eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof in loose rows and osteoclasts are multinucleated single cells, unlike this dense epithelial-like cluster.

ddx.dx: Aggregated blasts in acute leukemia or lymphoma
ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are discohesive and spread as single cells; true cohesion favors carcinoma or other solid tumor, confirmed by keratin-positive IHC.

62010.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑之間造血組織明顯多於脂肪，局部細胞量偏高（以老年人而言屬於過度增生），並散在巨核細胞；高細胞量合併周邊血球減少，是 MDS 評估中需先注意的低倍線索。
features: Low-power core biopsy with bony trabeculae and intertrabecular marrow spaces
Increased cellularity centrally (roughly 60-70%) with less cellular subcortical areas
Trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered megakaryocytes
No lymphoid aggregates, granulomas, fibrosis, or tumor infiltrates at this magnification
Trabeculae unremarkable in thickness
62010.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows intertrabecular marrow spaces with increased cellularity for age, estimated at approximately 60-70% in the central area, with less cellular subcortical regions. Trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered megakaryocytes is present. No lymphoid aggregates, granulomas, or infiltrating lymphoma are seen at this magnification, which is relevant to the PCNSL staging context. The hypercellular marrow in a patient with cytopenias is compatible with a myelodysplastic neoplasm, confirmed on higher-power and aspirate evaluation as MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Lymphoma involvement shows lymphoid aggregates or interstitial infiltrates, none of which are seen in this field.
MPNs show hypercellularity with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and often fibrosis, with blood counts elevated rather than cytopenias.
These show markedly decreased cellularity, opposite to the increased cellularity here.

61946.recognize_zh: CD4免疫染色中，許多中小型T細胞呈強膜狀陽性，組織球則為較淡的背景陽性，而大量淋巴細胞為陰性，顯示CD4+ T細胞只是混合族群的一部分，屬於反應性表現。
features: Numerous small-to-intermediate lymphocytes with strong membranous CD4 staining
Weaker, granular CD4 staining in histiocytes producing a diffuse light-brown background
Many admixed CD4-negative lymphocytes, including larger cells
Scattered, non-clustered distribution without sheets of CD4-positive atypical cells
61946.describe_en: CD4 immunohistochemistry highlights numerous small-to-intermediate T cells with strong membranous staining, admixed with weakly positive histiocytes and many CD4-negative lymphocytes. The positive cells are distributed in a scattered, mixed pattern without sheets of atypical CD4-positive cells. In conjunction with other stains (typically an expanded CD8+ population in EBV reactivation), the pattern supports a reactive mixed T-cell infiltrate.

ddx.vs: AITL shows CD4+ neoplastic T cells clustered around HEVs with PD1/CXCL13/ICOS co-expression and expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks, rather than scattered CD4+ cells in a polymorphous background.
PTCL typically shows sheets of atypical T cells with aberrant loss of pan-T antigens and a monoclonal TCR rearrangement.
In cHL, CD4+ T cells rosette around CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells, which is not seen here.

61882.recognize_zh: 周邊血液紅血球呈小球性低色素並有大小不等，骨髓抹片細胞豐富、可見巨核細胞與成熟中的骨髓系及紅血球系前驅細胞；配合 SIFD 症候群（TRNT1 突變的鐵粒幼細胞貧血合併 B 細胞免疫缺陷）臨床背景，重點在紅血球系以外譜系的變化。
features: Peripheral blood with hypochromic, microcytic red cells showing anisocytosis and mild poikilocytosis
Cellular bone marrow aspirate with megakaryocytes, including a large lobulated megakaryocyte
Abundant granulocytic and erythroid precursors at various stages of maturation
Low-power aspirate field with megakaryocytes and cellular particles
Special stain panel (D) with arrows indicating positively stained cells; stain type not labeled and not resolvable at this resolution
61882.describe_en: Composite of peripheral blood and bone marrow aspirate findings. The peripheral smear (A) shows hypochromic, microcytic red cells with anisocytosis and mild poikilocytosis. The aspirate smears (B, C) are cellular, with megakaryocytes and trilineage precursors including maturing granulocytes and erythroid cells. Panel D is a special or cytochemical stain with arrows highlighting positive cells; the stain and target cannot be reliably identified at this resolution, and ring sideroblasts are not demonstrable on the images provided. Findings are compatible with the marrow changes described in SIFD syndrome (sideroblastic anemia, B-cell immunodeficiency, periodic fevers and developmental delay due to TRNT1 mutations), which requires Prussian blue staining and genetic confirmation.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency also causes hypochromic microcytosis but shows absent marrow iron stores and no ring sideroblasts on Prussian blue staining.
ALAS2-related anemia is confined to the erythroid lineage without immunodeficiency, fevers or developmental delay, and is distinguished by genetic testing.
Pearson syndrome shows prominent vacuolization of erythroid and myeloid precursors with ring sideroblasts and pancreatic insufficiency caused by mitochondrial DNA deletion.
MDS-RS occurs in older adults with unilineage or multilineage dysplasia and SF3B1 mutation, rather than a congenital syndrome in childhood.

61818.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆嗜中性球核形不規則，數個核葉擠在一起並有一個近乎分離的小葉，細胞質顆粒偏少且分布不均，屬於核分葉異常的發育不良嗜中性球；背景可見少數淚滴形紅血球。
features: Neutrophil with irregular, crowded nuclear lobes and one nearly detached small lobe
Coarse clumped chromatin
Cytoplasm with sparse, unevenly distributed granules
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis including occasional teardrop and irregular forms
Scattered normal-sized platelets
61818.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with abnormal nuclear segmentation, with irregular crowded lobes, a nearly detached small lobe and coarse chromatin, and cytoplasm with sparse, unevenly distributed granules. Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional teardrop and irregular forms, and scattered platelets are present. The finding in a single cell is not diagnostic by itself and should be assessed across the smear. Findings are suggestive of dysgranulopoiesis in a myeloid neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Normal neutrophils have three to four evenly spaced lobes connected by thin filaments and uniform fine granulation.
Megaloblastic neutrophils show six or more connected lobes with normal granulation and accompanying macro-ovalocytes.
Toxic neutrophils show coarse dark toxic granulation, Dohle bodies and vacuoles rather than hypogranular cytoplasm.

61754.recognize_zh: 高倍脾臟 H&E 中，紅髓的血竇與索之間充滿中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓到卵圓、染色質略開放、帶小核仁、有中量淡色細胞質，圍繞中央粉紅色纖維小樑並夾雜含鐵血黃素；紅髓中這類中型邊緣區樣細胞浸潤符合脾臟邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, slightly open chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amounts of pale to amphophilic cytoplasm, giving a monocytoid/marginal zone-like appearance
Cells permeate red pulp cords and sinuses among abundant red blood cells
Central pink fibrous trabecula/perivascular collagen with cells streaming around it
Scattered brown hemosiderin pigment; no necrosis or significant mitotic activity evident
Several cells are relatively large with vesicular nuclei, so transformation should be excluded on the whole slide
61754.describe_en: High-power section of spleen shows red pulp cords and sinuses infiltrated by small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, slightly open chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm, surrounding a central fibrous trabecula. Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages and abundant red cells are present, and neither necrosis nor brisk mitotic activity is evident. A proportion of cells appear relatively large with vesicular chromatin, so the whole specimen should be assessed for large-cell transformation. In the context of the immunoprofile and light-chain restriction in this case, the findings are consistent with splenic marginal zone lymphoma with red pulp infiltration.

ddx.vs: Cells have evenly spaced bean-shaped nuclei with abundant clear 'fried-egg' cytoplasm forming blood lakes, and are CD103, CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positive.
Cells have irregular, cleaved nuclei with scant cytoplasm and express cyclin D1/SOX11 with CD5.
Consists of sheets of large cells at least twice the size of a lymphocyte with prominent nucleoli and high Ki-67 rather than a predominantly small-to-medium population.
Red pulp contains a mixture of erythroid precursors, myeloid cells and megakaryocytes instead of a monomorphous B-cell population.

61690.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（CD3 對 CD52，淋巴球閘門），非形態影像；大量藍色族群為 CD3 陽性且 CD52 表現，旁邊有 CD3 稍弱的綠色族群與 CD3 陰性的洋紅色族群，CD52 表現與 T-PLL 使用 alemtuzumab 治療有關。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD3-PC5.5 (x-axis) versus CD52-PE (y-axis), gated on [Lymphs]
Dense dominant blue population with CD3 expression (about 10^2) and CD52 expression spanning roughly 10^0 to 10^1
Adjacent green CD3-positive population with slightly dimmer CD3 and similar or slightly brighter CD52
Magenta CD3-negative population with CD52 expression, representing non-T lymphocytes
Few scattered red events near the CD3-positive clusters
61690.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the lymphocyte gate displays CD3 versus CD52 expression. A large, dominant CD3-positive population (blue) expresses CD52, alongside a smaller CD3-positive population with slightly dimmer CD3 (green) and a CD3-negative, CD52-positive population (magenta). Colour assignment and quantitative intensity reference are not provided, so relative CD52 brightness of the neoplastic cells cannot be judged precisely from this plot alone. The expansion of a CD52-expressing CD3-positive population is consistent with the given diagnosis of T-prolymphocytic leukemia, in which CD52 expression supports alemtuzumab-based therapy.

61626.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見數個巨核細胞核呈單一圓形、分葉少（hypolobated），夾雜紅血球前驅細胞與小血管、纖維間質；H&E 下無法看到環狀鐵粒母細胞，這些巨核細胞異常僅作為發育不良的輔助線索。
features: Megakaryocytes with small, round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei and abundant pink cytoplasm
Numerous erythroid precursors with round, dark nuclei and perinuclear clearing
Admixed granulocytic cells and scattered lymphocytes
Loose edematous/fibrillary stroma with small vessels and focal collagen
Ring sideroblasts not evaluable on H&E
61626.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a mixed hematopoietic population with abundant erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells in a loose, edematous stroma containing small vessels. Several megakaryocytes have small round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei, a feature suggestive of megakaryocytic dysplasia. Blasts are not conspicuously increased. Ring sideroblasts cannot be assessed on H&E; correlation with an iron-stained aspirate and SF3B1 status is required, and dysplasia in more than one lineage would favor MDS-RS with multilineage dysplasia over single-lineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Del(5q) MDS is characterized by numerous small monolobated megakaryocytes with isolated 5q deletion on karyotype, typically with macrocytic anemia and preserved platelets.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: MDS/MPN-RS-T shows large, ET-like hyperlobated megakaryocytes with thrombocytosis ≥450×10^9/L, not small hypolobated forms.
Reactive marrows may show edema and occasional small megakaryocytes, but lack consistent megakaryocytic dysplasia and ring sideroblasts.

61498.recognize_zh: G 顯帶核型圖中第 5 號染色體被圈起來，其中一條的長臂明顯比同源染色體短（中間段缺失），其餘染色體數目與結構看起來正常，標示為 46,XX,del(5)(q22q34)[20]，即單獨 5q 缺失的 MDS。
features: G-banded karyotype of a female (XX) with 46 chromosomes arranged by size and centromere position
Circled chromosome 5 pair: one homolog has a visibly shortened long arm with loss of mid-distal 5q bands
No other numerical or structural abnormality apparent; marker (mar) slot empty
Figure legend states 46,XX,del(5)(q22q34)[20], i.e., the deletion in all 20 metaphases analyzed
Banding resolution is modest, so precise breakpoints rely on the reported karyotype rather than the image alone
61498.describe_en: This is a G-banded karyotype from a bone marrow aspirate culture of a female patient, not a morphologic image. The chromosome 5 pair (circled) shows one normal homolog and one with an interstitial deletion of the long arm, reported as del(5)(q22q34), present in all 20 metaphases examined; no additional clonal abnormalities are apparent. Interpretation: an isolated del(5q) in a patient with anemia and dysmegakaryopoiesis supports myelodysplastic neoplasm with low blasts and isolated 5q deletion (MDS-5q), which carries a favorable prognosis and responds to lenalidomide; TP53 status should be assessed because a TP53 mutation worsens the outlook.

ddx.vs: In complex karyotypes del(5q) is accompanied by three or more other abnormalities (often -7 or 17p loss), whereas here it is the sole change.
WHO still allows MDS-5q with one extra abnormality except -7/del(7q); this karyotype shows no second abnormality.
Karyotype may look similar; the distinction depends on prior cytotoxic therapy history and usual co-occurring TP53 mutation.

61434.recognize_zh: 雙重酯酶染色中，大多數母細胞胞質呈瀰漫棕紅色（非特異性酯酶，α-naphthyl butyrate esterase 陽性），僅少數細胞呈藍色（chloroacetate esterase 陽性的顆粒球系前驅細胞），提示單核球系白血病。
features: Large blasts with round to slightly irregular outlines and abundant cytoplasm
Diffuse brown-red cytoplasmic reaction for nonspecific (alpha-naphthyl butyrate) esterase in the majority of blasts
Rare cells (two in field) with granular blue cytoplasmic reaction for chloroacetate esterase, marking granulocytic precursors
Double-positive cells not evident; the two lineages stain separately
Background of unstained red cells and a few smudged/disrupted cells with faint brown staining
61434.describe_en: Cytochemical double esterase stain of a smear shows a population of large blasts, the majority of which demonstrate diffuse brown-red cytoplasmic nonspecific (alpha-naphthyl butyrate) esterase activity. Only rare cells show blue granular chloroacetate esterase activity, consistent with residual granulocytic precursors. Findings support monocytic differentiation of the blasts and are consistent with acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: AMML requires at least 20% neutrophil lineage cells, which would show many more chloroacetate esterase-positive (blue) cells than the rare ones seen here.
Granulocytic blasts are chloroacetate esterase- and MPO-positive and lack diffuse nonspecific esterase activity.
Megakaryoblasts may show focal nonspecific esterase, but the reaction is fluoride-resistant and dot-like rather than diffuse, and they express CD41/CD61.
Lymphoblasts are negative for nonspecific esterase (or show only focal dot positivity) and lack chloroacetate esterase.

61370.recognize_zh: 血片中一顆比紅血球大的圓形深紫色核，染色質致密塊狀，幾乎沒有細胞質，只在邊緣黏附少許血小板樣碎片，是游離的裸巨核細胞核（bare megakaryocyte nucleus），勿誤認為淋巴球。
features: Round, compact nucleus about 1.5-2 times the diameter of an erythrocyte
Dense, coarsely clumped dark purple chromatin without nucleoli
Essentially no surrounding cytoplasm
Small platelet-like cytoplasmic fragments adherent to the nuclear surface
Background erythrocytes unremarkable
61370.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a naked megakaryocyte nucleus, a round compact nucleus with dense clumped chromatin, no cytoplasmic rim and small adherent platelet-like fragments at the periphery.
