Surrounding red cells are unremarkable in this field. Circulating bare megakaryocyte nuclei are most often associated with myeloproliferative neoplasms, particularly primary myelofibrosis, and should prompt review for leukoerythroblastosis, teardrop cells and abnormal platelets.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a thin but visible rim of blue cytoplasm and lack platelet fragments budding from the nuclear surface.
Smudge cells are crushed nuclei with a smeared, lacy, flattened chromatin pattern rather than an intact compact nucleus.
Micromegakaryocytes retain a rim of granular or blebbed cytoplasm around a small nucleus.
Nucleated red cells have a smaller pyknotic nucleus surrounded by hemoglobinized pink-orange cytoplasm.

61306.recognize_zh: 抹片中散在數個大型母細胞，核圓形或腎形略有凹痕、染色質細緻，細胞質中等量、灰藍色且無顆粒；帶凹痕核的前單核球與單核母細胞混合出現，符合單核球系白血病復發。
features: Several large blasts with round to reniform, slightly indented nuclei
Fine chromatin with faint nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm, some cells with eccentric nuclei
Admixture of monoblast-like and promonocyte-like forms with nuclear indentation
No Auer rods seen; background red cells with occasional crenated forms and a platelet clump
61306.describe_en: Marrow smear shows scattered large blasts with round to reniform, focally indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, faint nucleoli, and moderate amounts of grey-blue agranular cytoplasm. Forms with nuclear indentation resembling promonocytes are admixed with rounder monoblast-like cells. Auer rods are not seen, and background red cells show occasional crenation with a small platelet clump. In a patient with known acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia, these findings are consistent with relapse; confirmation with nonspecific esterase and flow cytometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: AMML contains ≥20% granulocytic lineage cells, including MPO-positive myeloblasts and maturing granulocytes, in addition to monocytic cells.
CMML has mostly mature monocytes with condensed chromatin and blasts plus promonocytes below 20%.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and lack nuclear folding and nonspecific esterase activity.

61242.recognize_zh: 周邊血中芽細胞的細胞核內有一個大而圓、淡染的區域，大小約佔核的一半，看起來像巨大核仁，其實是杯狀核凹陷（cup-like invagination），常見於 NPM1/FLT3 突變的 AML。
features: Blasts about 1.5-2 times the size of a red cell with high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Large, pale, round central clear zone occupying roughly half of the nuclear area (cup-like nuclear invagination) mimicking a giant nucleolus
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules visible in these blasts
Background red cells with a smudged/disrupted cell at top and several overlapping erythrocytes
61242.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. A prominent pale, round nuclear invagination occupying up to half of the nuclear area is present in at least one blast, producing a 'cup-like' appearance that mimics a very large nucleolus. A smudged cell is noted at the top of the field; Auer rods are not seen. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, a morphology strongly associated with NPM1 mutation with or without FLT3-ITD, typically CD34-negative with normal karyotype.

ddx.vs: Blasts show bilobed or folded 'butterfly' nuclei with fine granules and Auer rods, are HLA-DR/CD34 negative, and carry PML::RARA.
True nucleoli are well-demarcated, basophilic-blue structures within the chromatin, whereas the cup-like invagination is a pale, clear zone lacking nucleolar staining.
Lymphoblasts may have nuclear clefts but not a large central cup-like invagination and are MPO negative with B- or T-lineage markers.

61178.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中可見大型、成群或融合成團的非造血細胞，細胞質深藍、細胞核重疊、邊界不清，與周圍正常造血細胞明顯不同，這種黏聚性腫瘤細胞團提示轉移性腫瘤，配合病史為神經母細胞瘤（neuroblastoma）。
features: Cohesive clusters and syncytial clumps of large tumor cells with overlapping, molded nuclei
Marked size variation (pleomorphism); nuclei round to oval with fine to smudged chromatin
Moderate to abundant deep-blue cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Tumor cells present singly and in clusters, far larger than surrounding hematopoietic cells
Paucity of normal hematopoietic elements in the field; background red cells and fine granular debris
No definite Homer Wright rosettes or fibrillary neuropil appreciable at this magnification
61178.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters and syncytial aggregates of large, pleomorphic non-hematopoietic cells, with scattered single tumor cells. The cells have round to oval nuclei with nuclear molding and overlapping, fine chromatin, and moderate to abundant deep basophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders. Normal hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field. Rosettes and fibrillary material are not clearly identified. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a metastatic tumor, compatible with neuroblastoma in the given clinical context; immunostains (PHOX2B, synaptophysin) on the core biopsy are recommended.

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are discohesive and evenly dispersed rather than forming molded syncytial clusters, and are CD45/CD34 positive.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells may also cluster and can be vacuolated but are desmin/myogenin positive and lack neuropil.
Carcinoma clusters show more cohesive sheets with defined borders in adults and are cytokeratin positive, whereas neuroblastoma is cytokeratin negative.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a paranuclear clear zone and megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei with granular cytoplasm, unlike these molded atypical cells.

61114.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片明顯細胞過多，巨核細胞數量增加且大小不一、有群聚，部分為小型、核分葉少的形態；中央可見一團由小型成熟淋巴球組成的非小梁旁結節，對應殘存的 CLL，是治療相關骨髓腫瘤與 CLL 並存的線索。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow for age with reduced fat
Increased megakaryocytes with variable size, loose clustering and some small hypolobated forms
Well-circumscribed non-paratrabecular nodular aggregate of small, dark, round lymphocytes (CLL component)
Trilineage hematopoiesis with abundant erythroid and granulocytic elements in the background
Sheets of blasts not evident at this magnification
61114.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes are increased, variable in size and loosely clustered, including small forms with hypolobated nuclei. A well-circumscribed non-paratrabecular nodular aggregate of small mature lymphocytes is present, consistent with residual chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Megakaryocytic dysplasia is suggested but is better appraised on high-power and aspirate smears, and blast enumeration requires CD34 immunostaining and the aspirate. In a patient with prior cytotoxic therapy, the findings are suggestive of a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm (MDS type) with concurrent CLL involvement.

ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows orderly maturation and normal-appearing megakaryocytes, whereas t-MN shows dysplastic small hypolobated megakaryocytes and often abnormal p53 or cytogenetics.
Benign aggregates are small, loose and mixed T/B with vessels, whereas CLL nodules are larger, well-circumscribed and composed of CD5+ CD23+ LEF1+ B cells.
MPN megakaryocytes are large and hyperlobated (ET, PMF with cloud-like nuclei) rather than small and hypolobated, and driver mutations (JAK2/CALR/MPL) are present.
Richter transformation shows sheets of large cells within the lymphoid component, which is not seen in this small-cell nodule.

61050.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆大型巨核細胞旁邊，有胞質充滿大小不等透明空泡的泡沫狀組織球（foamy histiocytes），吞入細胞看不出來，屬非特異性的反應性變化，需配合臨床考慮儲積症等原因。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm filled with numerous clear vacuoles of varying size (foamy/soap-bubble appearance)
Small nuclei partly obscured by vacuoles
Adjacent large megakaryocyte with lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm for size comparison
No engulfed hematopoietic cells or organisms evident within the histiocytes
Background of red cells and a few maturing myeloid cells
61050.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm distended by numerous clear vacuoles of variable size, lying beside a normal-appearing megakaryocyte. No hemophagocytosis, microorganisms or crystalline inclusions are identified. Foamy histiocytes are a nonspecific finding and may be seen after chemotherapy, in marrow injury, hyperlipidemia or lipid storage disorders. In a child with suspected lysosomal storage disease, correlation with enzyme assays (e.g., acid sphingomyelinase) and genetic testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Niemann-Pick cells show uniform fine foamy vacuolation across many histiocytes; morphology alone cannot distinguish them from reactive foamy macrophages without enzyme assay.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary crumpled-paper cytoplasm rather than discrete clear vacuoles.
Hemophagocytosis shows engulfed red cells, platelets or nucleated cells within the macrophage cytoplasm, which are not seen here.

60986.recognize_zh: 骨髓流式細胞圖中紅色族群位於 CD45 弱陽性、低側散射（blast 區），HLA-DR 強陽性、CD4 陽性、CD56 部分陽性，CD123 強陽性且 CD34 陰性，這個「CD4+/CD56+/CD123 bright/CD34−」組合即 BPDCN 的免疫表型。
features: CD45 vs SSC: red abnormal population with dim CD45 and low side scatter, distinct from lymphocytes (green), monocytes (cyan) and granulocytes (orange)
HLA-DR vs CD33: red population HLA-DR bright with CD33 negative to dim
CD56 vs CD4: red population uniformly CD4 positive with heterogeneous negative-to-positive CD56
CD123 vs CD34: red population CD123 bright and CD34 negative
Non-morphologic figure; lineage-specific markers (MPO, cCD3, CD19, TCF4/TCL1, CD303) not shown
60986.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the bone marrow aspirate identifies an abnormal population (red) with dim CD45 and low side scatter. These cells are HLA-DR bright, CD33 negative to dim, CD4 positive, CD56 variably positive, CD123 bright and CD34 negative. This immunophenotype is characteristic of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, and confirmation should include negativity for MPO and lineage-specific T/B markers with expression of additional pDC markers (TCF4, TCL1, CD303).

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Also CD4/CD56-positive with bright CD123 in some cases, but expresses CD33/CD13, CD11b/CD14/CD64 or lysozyme and lacks CD303/TCF4.
Normal pDCs are CD123 bright/HLA-DR+ but CD56-negative and present as a small minor population rather than a dominant blast-like population.
CD56-positive but CD123- and HLA-DR-negative, with cytotoxic markers and CD2/cCD3epsilon expression.

ddx.dx: Early T-precursor or mixed-phenotype acute leukemia
ddx.vs: Express cCD3 and/or MPO and often CD34/CD7, which the BPDCN population lacks.

60922.recognize_zh: 脾臟切片中一個圓形纖維化結節，內含金褐色與深藍黑色、帶裂隙的鈣化及鐵沉積物（含鐵血黃素與鈣鹽沉積在膠原纖維上），周圍有出血與充血的紅髓，中央有小血管，即 Gamna-Gandy 小體。
features: Well-circumscribed fibrotic nodule within congested splenic red pulp
Golden-brown to black-blue encrustations on collagen and elastic fibers (hemosiderin and calcium deposition)
Brittle, cracked/fissured appearance of the mineralized material
Small thick-walled vessel within the nodule
Surrounding rim of fresh hemorrhage and congested red pulp
60922.describe_en: Section of spleen at low power shows a well-circumscribed fibrotic nodule set within congested red pulp and rimmed by fresh hemorrhage. The nodule contains dense collagen encrusted by golden-brown and dark blue-black, brittle, fissured deposits consistent with hemosiderin and calcium salts, surrounding a small vessel. No granulomatous inflammation, organisms or neoplastic cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a Gamna-Gandy (siderotic) nodule, reflecting organized prior hemorrhage, as seen in portal hypertension/congestive splenomegaly and sickle cell disease.

ddx.vs: The fibers encrusted with iron and calcium can resemble fungal hyphae, but true hyphae have parallel walls, septa and regular branching and stain with GMS without being Prussian blue positive.
Calcified granulomas show concentric hyalinized necrosis, sometimes with residual organisms, rather than iron-encrusted collagen around a vessel with hemorrhage.
Infarcts are wedge-shaped with ghost architecture and fibrosis, lacking prominent ferrocalcinotic encrustation of fibers.
SANT forms multiple angiomatoid nodules with CD34/CD31/CD8 vascular patterns separated by fibrous stroma, not a single mineralized siderotic nodule.

60858.recognize_zh: 中倍皮膚切片中，小型成熟淋巴細胞浸潤緊密包圍並滲入一個充滿角質的毛囊漏斗部上皮，周圍夾雜細胞質較淡的組織球／邊緣區樣細胞，此附屬器周圍浸潤型態可見於皮膚邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Dilated follicular infundibulum containing laminated keratin, surrounded by squamous epithelium
Dense infiltrate of small round lymphocytes with dark nuclei encircling and percolating the infundibular epithelium
Admixed cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (histiocytes and/or marginal zone-type cells), particularly at left
Infiltrate dissects between dermal collagen bundles
No significant atypia or large-cell sheets at this power
60858.describe_en: Dermal section shows a keratin-filled follicular infundibulum surrounded by a dense infiltrate of small lymphocytes that percolates around and invests the follicular epithelium. The infiltrate is admixed with cells having pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, including histiocytes and marginal zone-type cells, and extends between collagen bundles. Sheets of large atypical cells are not seen. Findings are compatible with a periadnexal small B-cell infiltrate of cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma in the appropriate immunophenotypic context.

ddx.dx: Ruptured follicular cyst with reactive inflammation
ddx.vs: A ruptured cyst produces a mixed neutrophilic and granulomatous reaction with foreign-body giant cells around keratin, rather than a dense monotonous small lymphoid infiltrate.
FMF shows atypical T cells infiltrating follicular epithelium, often with follicular mucinosis, whereas here the lymphocytes surround the follicle and are B-cell rich.
Reactive infiltrates show a polymorphous population with polarized germinal centers and polytypic plasma cells.

60794.recognize_zh: 淋巴結內多個濾泡，中心為小而深染的淋巴球，外圍被較大、淡染的細胞包圍（B），與一般濾泡「中心淡、外圍深」相反；外圍大細胞 CD10 與 BCL2 陽性（D、E），CD21 顯示濾泡樹突網存在（G），BCL2 FISH 異常，符合反轉型濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A: lymph node with multiple nodules extending into perinodal fat
Panel B: follicle with a central dark zone of small lymphocytes surrounded by a broad rim of larger pale cells (reverse pattern)
Panel C: CD20 positive throughout with darker staining of the central small cell aggregate
Panels D-E: CD10 and strong BCL2 positivity in the neoplastic cells, including the pale peripheral zone
Panel F: weak/partial BCL6 nuclear staining; Panel G: CD21 highlights follicular dendritic cell meshworks in multiple nodules
Panel H: BCL2 FISH with fusion/split signals indicating BCL2 rearrangement
60794.describe_en: Lymph node section (A) shows a nodular proliferation with nodules extending into perinodal adipose tissue. At higher power (B) the nodules show a reverse pattern: a central aggregate of small dark lymphocytes surrounded by a wide peripheral zone of larger, paler cells with more abundant cytoplasm. The neoplastic cells are CD20 positive (C) and express CD10 (D) and strong BCL2 (E), with weaker BCL6 (F); CD21 (G) highlights follicular dendritic cell meshworks, and FISH (H) demonstrates a BCL2 rearrangement. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma with a reverse (inverted) follicular pattern.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Pale marginal zone cells also surround residual follicles but are CD10 negative and lack BCL2 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Expanded mantle zones surround reactive germinal centers but are CD5+/cyclin D1+ and CD10 negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia with marginal zone hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Germinal centers are BCL2 negative with polarization and tingible-body macrophages, and there is no BCL2 rearrangement.
Nodules contain scattered CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells within expanded mantle zones rather than a CD10+/BCL2+ monoclonal B-cell population.

60794.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, CD10, BCL2, BCL6, CD21; FISH: BCL2

60602.recognize_zh: 皮膚出現中央暗紫藍色、外圍紅暈的結節（類似靶狀壞死性病灶）；切片中血管腔內可見大量分隔菌絲（箭頭）堵塞血管，屬於血管侵犯型黴菌，在中性球低下的 AML 病人應考慮鐮刀菌（Fusarium）。
features: Clinical photo: solitary violaceous to blue-gray papulonodular skin lesion with a surrounding erythematous rim
Skin/subcutis section: thick-walled vessel whose lumen is occluded by a mesh of pale, septate fungal hyphae (arrow)
Hyphae appear narrow and parallel/branching, filling the lumen as a thrombus
Minimal surrounding inflammatory infiltrate, consistent with neutropenia
Adjacent skeletal muscle fibers without obvious fungal invasion in this field
60602.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a violaceous nodular skin lesion with a central dusky blue discoloration and an erythematous halo. The corresponding biopsy (H&E) shows a blood vessel in the deep dermis/subcutis whose lumen is filled with septate fungal hyphae, forming an intravascular fungal thrombus, with scant inflammatory response. Species identification is not possible from morphology alone; hyaline septate hyphae with angioinvasion in a neutropenic patient are consistent with disseminated fusariosis, pending culture or molecular confirmation.

ddx.vs: Aspergillus hyphae are morphologically indistinguishable in tissue (acute-angle branching septate hyphae), but positive blood cultures and multiple skin lesions favor Fusarium; culture or PCR is required.
Mucorales show broad, ribbon-like, pauci-septate hyphae with right-angle branching rather than narrow septate hyphae.
Pseudomonas lesions show perivascular gram-negative bacilli and necrosis without fungal hyphae on GMS/PAS stains.
Leukemia cutis shows a dermal infiltrate of blasts rather than intravascular fungal elements.

60666.recognize_zh: 同一抹片中嗜中性球、嗜酸性球（橘紅顆粒）與嗜鹼性球（深紫粗顆粒）都出現核分葉過多（多於 5 葉），三種顆粒球系列同時受影響，符合羥基脲（hydroxycarbamide）引起的巨母紅血球樣變化。
features: Panels A–C: eosinophils with orange-red granules and nuclei divided into 4–6 or more lobes (normal eosinophils are bilobed)
Panels D–F: basophils with coarse dark purple-black granules partly obscuring nuclei that appear multilobated
Panels G–I: neutrophils with 6 or more distinct nuclear lobes connected by thin filaments (hypersegmentation)
Background red cells mildly macrocytic/oval with occasional stomatocyte-like forms
Granulocyte cytoplasm and granulation otherwise normal; no Döhle bodies or toxic granulation
60666.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows nuclear hypersegmentation affecting all three granulocytic lineages. Neutrophils contain six or more lobes, eosinophils show four to six lobes instead of the normal bilobed configuration, and basophils have multilobated nuclei partially obscured by coarse granules. Red cells appear mildly macrocytic with some oval forms, and cytoplasmic granulation is otherwise normal. Findings are consistent with drug-induced megaloblastoid change due to hydroxycarbamide (hydroxyurea), although vitamin B12/folate deficiency should be excluded.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so distinction relies on serum B12/folate, methylmalonic acid/homocysteine and drug history.
The inherited trait affects neutrophils only, without macrocytosis, and persists without drug exposure.
MDS more often shows hypolobated (pseudo-Pelger) and hypogranular neutrophils with cytopenias and clonal abnormalities rather than uniform hypersegmentation across all granulocytes.
Iron deficiency can cause mild neutrophil hypersegmentation but with microcytic hypochromic red cells rather than macrocytes.

60730.recognize_zh: 周邊血出現核偏位、細胞質深藍並有核旁淡染區的成熟漿細胞，外觀像漿細胞白血病；但流式細胞儀 CD38 陽性細胞同時表現 cytoplasmic kappa（約 60%）與 lambda（約 30%），屬多株性，證實為 T 細胞淋巴瘤引發的反應性漿細胞增多。
features: Circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, moderately clumped chromatin and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Perinuclear clearing (hof) evident in some cells; no nucleoli or immature plasmablastic features
Mature-appearing, fairly uniform cytology without multinucleation
Flow cytometry: gated CD38-bright population with both cytoplasmic kappa (~60%) and cytoplasmic lambda (~30%) subsets, a polytypic pattern
Background red cells without obvious rouleaux
60730.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating mature plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, perinuclear hofs and abundant intensely basophilic cytoplasm. Morphologically these could suggest plasma cell leukemia. Flow cytometric analysis of the CD38-bright population, however, shows both cytoplasmic kappa- and lambda-expressing subsets in an approximately 2:1 ratio, indicating a polytypic, reactive plasma cell population. Findings are consistent with reactive peripheral blood plasmacytosis in the setting of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, rather than plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: PCL shows a single light-chain–restricted CD38+/CD138+ population, often CD19−/CD56+, with a serum M-protein, whereas this population is polytypic.
AITL also causes polytypic plasmacytosis and hypergammaglobulinemia, and is separated from PTCL-NOS by TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13, ICOS) on tissue.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis from infection (e.g., viral, dengue, sepsis)
ddx.vs: Morphology and polyclonality are identical, so separation requires clinical context and a demonstrable T-cell neoplasm.
LPL shows a light-chain–restricted spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 mutation.

captions: Peripheral blood: circulating mature plasma cells with basophilic cytoplasm and hofs
Flow cytometry: CD38+ cells with both cytoplasmic kappa and lambda subsets (polytypic)

60538.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中，大型不典型淋巴樣細胞核不規則、有凹陷，細胞質深藍色，左上方那顆含許多小空泡；它們夾雜在細胞質帶粉紅顆粒、核呈腎形的骨髓性前驅細胞之間，體積明顯較大、細胞質更嗜鹼，符合 ATLL 侵犯骨髓的多形表現。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented to lobulated nuclei and moderately condensed chromatin
Moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm; one cell (upper left) with numerous small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Occasional small nucleoli; no well-developed flower-cell morphology
Admixed residual myeloid precursors (metamyelocytes/bands with pink granular cytoplasm and kidney-shaped nuclei) for comparison
Hemodilute proteinaceous background with scattered red cells and platelets
60538.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows large atypical lymphoid cells admixed with residual granulocytic precursors. The atypical cells have irregular, indented to lobulated nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and occasional nucleoli, and a moderate amount of deeply basophilic cytoplasm; one cell contains numerous small clear vacuoles. Classic clover-leaf (flower) nuclei are not evident, and the vacuolated basophilic morphology overlaps with anaplastic large cell lymphoma and plasmablastic cells. With a CD3+/CD4+ phenotype and complete loss of CD5, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a mature T-cell neoplasm compatible with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, pending confirmation of HTLV-1 infection.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows hallmark horseshoe-shaped nuclei and strong uniform CD30, often ALK+, whereas ATLL is typically CD25+ and HTLV-1 associated.
Plasmablasts have eccentric round nuclei with a prominent single nucleolus and perinuclear hof and are CD138+/MUM1+ without CD3.
Burkitt cells are monotonous medium-sized cells with round nuclei and deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and a CD10+ B-cell phenotype with MYC rearrangement.
Monoblasts have fine chromatin with gray-blue cytoplasm and are CD64/CD14 and nonspecific esterase positive rather than CD3+.

60474.recognize_zh: 單顆中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓形略呈腎形、染色質均勻，細胞質豐富呈淡藍灰色、邊緣模糊並帶細小毛狀突起，是典型的毛狀細胞（hairy cell）。
features: Medium-sized cell about 1.5-2 times a red cell diameter
Low-to-moderate N:C ratio with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nucleus with homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Ill-defined, ruffled cytoplasmic border with fine hair-like projections
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; scattered platelets
60474.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single atypical lymphoid cell with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm and a ruffled border bearing fine circumferential cytoplasmic projections. The nucleus is round to slightly indented with homogeneous chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The background red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a circulating hairy cell, as seen in hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi and scantier basophilic cytoplasm and lack the CD25/CD103/annexin A1 profile.
HCL-v cells have a distinct central nucleolus and are CD25 and annexin A1 negative.
Monocytes have folded or lobulated nuclei with lacy chromatin and vacuolated gray cytoplasm without hair-like projections.

60154.recognize_zh: 視野中一顆比紅血球大約兩倍、核不規則且細胞質帶深紫色粗顆粒的未成熟顆粒球（immature granulocyte，約為骨髓細胞 myelocyte 階段），加上散在的淚滴形紅血球與血小板團，呈現骨髓纖維化的周邊血液表現。
features: Single granulocytic cell with an irregular nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin and purple-blue cytoplasm containing coarse dark granules concentrated at one pole, favoring an immature granulocyte (basophil not entirely excluded)
Occasional dacrocytes and oval/elongated red cells
Normocytic, normochromic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis and occasional polychromatophilic cells
Small platelet clump and scattered platelets
60154.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis, including occasional dacrocytes and ovalocytes. A single granulocytic cell with an irregular nucleus and coarse purple cytoplasmic granules is present, favored to represent an immature granulocyte, although a basophil cannot be excluded at this resolution. Platelets are present with a small clump. Findings are consistent with a leukoerythroblastic, myelofibrotic picture, compatible with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis in context.

ddx.vs: The peripheral blood findings are identical, so a documented history of polycythemia vera is required.
Shows toxic granulation and Döhle bodies without teardrop cells or nucleated red cells.
Shows marked leukocytosis with a myelocyte peak and absolute basophilia rather than isolated immature cells with teardrops, and carries BCR::ABL1.

60090.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中顆粒呈大脂肪空泡與稀疏基質條索構成的網狀結構，背景主要是紅血球，有核造血細胞非常稀少；脂肪空泡多、造血細胞少，代表明顯低細胞性骨髓。
features: Aspirate spicules composed of large empty fat spaces outlined by thin stromal strands
Very sparse nucleated hematopoietic cells scattered among red cells
Background dominated by red cells, without cellular trails
No clusters of blasts or abnormal cells seen
Cellular detail limited at this magnification
60090.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows spicules composed largely of empty fat spaces outlined by thin stromal strands, with very sparse nucleated hematopoietic cells in a background dominated by red cells. No abnormal cellular clusters are identified, although individual cell morphology cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The findings indicate a markedly hypocellular marrow with reduced trilineage hematopoiesis. In the clinical context of pancytopenia, findings are consistent with inherited bone marrow failure due to dyskeratosis congenita.

ddx.vs: Aspirate appearance is the same; telomere length testing by flow-FISH and germline genetics identify dyskeratosis congenita.
Also hypocellular; chromosomal breakage testing with DEB or mitomycin C distinguishes Fanconi anemia.

ddx.dx: Hemodilute aspirate from a normocellular marrow
ddx.vs: Hemodilution reduces nucleated cells but spicules retain hematopoietic cells, and the core biopsy shows normal cellularity.

60026.recognize_zh: 一群中到大型母細胞核質比高、染色質細緻，許多細胞核一側有淡染的凹陷區（杯狀核 cup-like nucleus，核內凹陷約佔核面積四分之一以上），這是 NPM1 突變 AML 的典型型態線索。
features: Cluster of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Nuclei with a pale, clear invagination (cup-like or 'fish-mouth' nuclear contour) in many cells
Fine, dispersed chromatin with small nucleoli visible in some cells
Scant to moderate agranular pale-blue cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
Background of normochromic red cells; no maturing granulocytes in field
60026.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of medium to large blasts with high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and small nucleoli. Many blasts display a distinct pale nuclear invagination producing a cup-shaped nuclear contour. The cytoplasm is scant to moderate, pale blue, and agranular, and Auer rods are not identified. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; the cup-like nuclear morphology is suggestive of AML with mutated NPM1 (or FLT3-ITD), to be confirmed by molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed or folded butterfly-shaped nuclei with occasional Auer rod bundles and strong MPO, whereas these blasts have cup-shaped invaginations and no Auer rods; PML::RARA testing separates them.
Monoblasts and promonocytes have abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with folded, delicate nuclei and are NSE positive, rather than scant cytoplasm with a discrete cup-like clearing.

ddx.dx: AML with FLT3-ITD without NPM1 mutation
ddx.vs: Cup-like blasts are also associated with FLT3-ITD, so morphology cannot separate them and molecular testing is required.
Lymphoblasts can show nuclear clefts but lack cup-like invaginations and are MPO negative with B- or T-lineage markers; NPM1-mutated AML is typically CD34 negative and HLA-DR negative.

30266.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有數個芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質嗜鹼性並有突出的細胞質泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），其中一個為雙核，這是巨核芽細胞（megakaryoblast）的特徵；在唐氏症新生兒即為暫時性異常骨髓增生（TAM）。
features: Blasts about two to three times red cell size with high N:C ratio and round nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with occasional faint nucleoli
Basophilic cytoplasm with prominent pale cytoplasmic blebs/budding projections
One binucleated blast with blebbed cytoplasm
Background red cells with numerous stomatocyte-like slit-shaped central pallor and a few echinocytes
30266.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa, oil immersion) shows several circulating blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, a high N:C ratio and basophilic cytoplasm with prominent cytoplasmic blebs, including a binucleated form. These features are characteristic of megakaryoblasts. The background red cells show many stomatocyte-like forms with slit-like central pallor, which may be partly artifactual. In a neonate with Down syndrome, findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis (transient myeloproliferative disorder); flow cytometry (CD41/CD61, CD34, CD117) and GATA1 mutation analysis support the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar, but it arises later (typically after the neonatal period, up to 4 years), is persistent, and often follows a myelodysplastic phase with additional mutations.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia in non-Down syndrome infants
ddx.vs: It lacks trisomy 21 and GATA1 mutation and often carries RBM15::MRTFA or CBFA2T3::GLIS2 fusions.
Lymphoblasts lack cytoplasmic blebs and express TdT, CD19 or CD3 rather than CD41/CD61.

ddx.dx: Platelets or giant platelets adherent to lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Platelet satellitism shows granular platelets attached outside the cell membrane, not cytoplasmic blebs continuous with a blast.

27898.recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片可見表皮下方整個真皮被密集、單一型態的小至中型細胞瀰漫浸潤，細胞在膠原束之間呈單排或條索狀穿插，僅留下一條窄的表皮下帶——這種皮膚瀰漫浸潤型態需考慮骨髓肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma，leukemia cutis）。
features: Dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate occupying the full thickness of the biopsy
Monotonous small-to-medium hyperchromatic cells
Cells dissecting between collagen bundles in single files and cords
Narrow, largely uninvolved subepidermal zone with intact overlying epidermis
No epidermotropism, necrosis or granuloma formation at this power
27898.describe_en: Low-power view of a skin biopsy shows an intact epidermis overlying a dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate of monotonous, hyperchromatic small-to-medium cells that splay apart collagen bundles in cords and single files. A thin subepidermal zone is relatively spared and there is no epidermotropism. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. The pattern is that of a diffuse hematolymphoid infiltrate and, in context, is consistent with myeloid sarcoma (leukemia cutis); immunohistochemistry (MPO, lysozyme, CD33, CD34, CD117, CD68/CD163) is required for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type
ddx.vs: Tumor cells are larger centroblasts/immunoblasts expressing CD20, BCL2, MUM1 and lacking myeloid markers.
Also a dermal blastic infiltrate with a grenz zone, but it is CD4/CD56/CD123/TCF4-positive and MPO/lysozyme-negative.
Small round blue cells with salt-and-pepper chromatin that are CK20 (perinuclear dot), synaptophysin and chromogranin positive and CD45-negative.
Sweet syndrome shows mature neutrophils with leukocytoclasis and papillary dermal edema rather than a monotonous blastic infiltrate.

23738.recognize_zh: 嬰兒周邊血抹片中可見數顆小型成熟淋巴球，染色質濃縮、細胞質極少，核上有明顯的深裂痕或凹陷（cleaved/notched nuclei），配合 2 個月大嬰兒持續咳嗽與淋巴球增多，是百日咳（Bordetella pertussis）的抹片線索。
features: Small mature lymphocytes with high N:C ratio and scant rim of blue cytoplasm
Nuclei with deep clefts, notches or indentations (cleaved lymphocytes)
Coarse, condensed mature chromatin without nucleoli
A neutrophil present at the edge; no blasts or reactive large lymphocytes seen
Normochromic red cells and scattered normal platelets
23738.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm, condensed chromatin and conspicuous nuclear clefts or notches. Nucleoli are not seen, and blasts or large reactive lymphocytes are not identified in this field. Red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. In a young infant with progressive cough, a lymphocytosis of small cleaved lymphocytes is suggestive of Bordetella pertussis infection; confirmation requires PCR or culture.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma or mantle cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: These adult lymphomas also show cleaved cells but are monoclonal B cells by flow cytometry and do not occur as a transient infantile lymphocytosis.
Lymphoblasts have fine, dispersed chromatin and possible nucleoli, unlike these mature cells with condensed chromatin.
Viral reactive lymphocytes are large with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, rather than small cells with cleaved nuclei.
Sezary cells show cerebriform, convoluted nuclei in adults with erythroderma and a CD4+CD7- T-cell phenotype.

13178.recognize_zh: 左圖腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片可見兩顆核偏位、染色質粗塊、胞質灰藍的漿細胞；右圖腦脊髓液免疫固定電泳顯示 IgG 與 kappa 同位置的單株帶、lambda 為陰性，符合骨髓瘤腦膜侵犯（meningeal myelomatosis）。
features: CSF cytospin with two plasma cells having eccentric round nuclei
Coarsely clumped chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone and irregular cell borders
Immunofixation of CSF: discrete band in ELP, IgG and kappa lanes at the same position
No band in the lambda lane, indicating monoclonal IgG kappa
13178.describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytospin shows plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin, and moderate amounts of basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear clear zone; the cytospin artifact slightly distorts cell borders. Immunofixation electrophoresis of the CSF demonstrates a discrete band in the electrophoresis, IgG, and kappa lanes with no corresponding lambda band, indicating a monoclonal IgG kappa protein matching the patient's known paraprotein. Findings are consistent with central nervous system involvement by plasma cell myeloma (meningeal myelomatosis); flow cytometry of the CSF can confirm clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are polytypic and accompanied by lymphocytes and monocytes, and oligoclonal bands rather than a single monoclonal IgG kappa band are seen.
Lymphoma cells have high N:C ratio, irregular nuclei, and scant cytoplasm without hof, and flow cytometry shows CD19/CD20 B cells rather than CD38/CD138 plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Serum paraprotein leak across a disrupted blood-brain barrier
ddx.vs: A CSF band alone can reflect passive transfer, so the presence of clonal plasma cells in the CSF is required to diagnose meningeal involvement.

18362.recognize_zh: 這是 CORAL 研究的 Kaplan-Meier 無惡化存活曲線（非形態學影像）：復發或難治 DLBCL 中，先前未用過 rituximab 者（紅線，約 43–47%）的 PFS 明顯優於先前用過 rituximab 者（藍線，約 20–23%），p = 0.0029。
features: Kaplan-Meier progression-free survival curves over about 76 months
Red curve: no prior rituximab, plateau around 43-47%
Blue curve: prior rituximab, steep early decline to below 30% by 12 months and plateau near 20%
Log-rank p = 0.0029
Most events occur within the first 12 months
18362.describe_en: This non-morphologic figure shows Kaplan-Meier progression-free survival from the CORAL salvage study in relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, stratified by prior rituximab exposure. Patients who had not received rituximab as part of first-line therapy had a PFS plateau of roughly 45%, whereas those relapsing after rituximab-containing therapy had a PFS of only about 20% (p = 0.0029). The interpretation is that relapse after R-CHOP identifies biologically more resistant disease with poorer outcomes after salvage chemotherapy and autologous transplantation.

16890.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一個巨大的組織球，細胞質充滿大小一致的小透明空泡，呈泡沫狀或桑椹狀（foam cell），細胞核小而居中，符合 Niemann-Pick 病的泡沫細胞。
features: Very large histiocyte many times the size of surrounding marrow cells
Abundant cytoplasm packed with innumerable uniform, small, clear vacuoles giving a foamy/soap-bubble (mulberry) appearance
Single relatively small, round-oval nucleus with coarse chromatin and a few pale areas
Pale bluish cytoplasmic background between vacuoles; no fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' texture
Surrounding granulocytic and erythroid precursors appear unremarkable
16890.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly enlarged macrophage whose abundant cytoplasm is distended by numerous uniform, small clear vacuoles, producing a foamy, soap-bubble appearance. The nucleus is relatively small and round with coarse chromatin. The cytoplasm lacks the striated, crumpled tissue-paper texture of Gaucher cells, and no sea-blue granules are evident in this field. Surrounding hematopoietic precursors appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with lipid-laden foam cells of Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary, striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm that is PAS positive, rather than discrete uniform clear vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green ceroid granules on Romanowsky stain, whereas Niemann-Pick cells are predominantly clear-vacuolated (though sea-blue cells may coexist, especially in type B/C).

ddx.dx: Secondary foamy macrophages (hyperlipidemia, TPN, pseudo-Gaucher in CML)
ddx.vs: Reactive foamy macrophages are usually fewer and smaller in a clinical context of lipid overload; enzyme assay (acid sphingomyelinase) or NPC1/NPC2 genetics confirm Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with atypical nuclei and are keratin positive, unlike a single benign histiocyte with a bland nucleus.

14842.recognize_zh: 無淋巴結腫大、以肝腫大與無結石膽囊炎表現的患者，周邊血可見大型不典型淋巴樣細胞（深藍細胞質、可見核仁，見放大插圖），肝臟切片中大型腫瘤細胞塞在肝竇（sinusoid）內，符合血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（intravascular large B-cell lymphoma）的白血病期。
features: PB: scattered large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, open chromatin, and visible nucleoli (inset)
PB: large cells are several times the size of red cells with high N:C ratio
BM biopsy (H&E): hypercellular interstitial infiltrate of large atypical cells between adipocytes
Liver (H&E): large atypical lymphoid cells confined within dilated hepatic sinusoids, without a mass-forming parenchymal infiltrate
Background PB red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis
14842.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered large atypical lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, open chromatin, and prominent nucleoli. The bone marrow biopsy shows an interstitial infiltrate of large atypical mononuclear cells. Sections of liver show large neoplastic lymphoid cells filling and distending hepatic sinusoids, with preserved hepatic plate architecture and no discrete tumor mass. Findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma with a leukemic component; confirmation with CD20/PAX5 immunostaining highlighting intravascular cells is recommended.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS with secondary liver involvement
ddx.vs: Conventional DLBCL forms mass lesions or portal/parenchymal infiltrates rather than being restricted to vessel lumina.
HSTCL is also sinusoidal but consists of medium-sized CD3+ CD4-/CD8- gamma-delta T cells, not large CD20+ B cells.
NK-cell leukemia cells contain azurophilic granules and are CD56+/cytoplasmic CD3+ and EBV-positive, lacking B-cell markers.
HLH shows sinusoidal histiocytes with phagocytosed blood cells rather than large atypical lymphoid cells with nucleoli.

12538.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中，中性球內塞滿多個橢圓形、周圍有透明暈的酵母菌，並可見出芽（箭頭）與延長的假菌絲（pseudohyphae），細胞外也有成串出芽的菌體，符合念珠菌血症（Candida albicans 敗血症）。
features: Neutrophils containing multiple oval, basophilic yeast cells (about 3-6 µm) surrounded by clear halos
Budding yeasts (arrows) and elongated sausage-shaped pseudohyphal forms
Extracellular chain of budding yeast/pseudohyphae between red cells
Host neutrophils show coarse toxic granulation and cytoplasmic vacuolation
Thrombocytopenia with few platelets; red cells show mild hypochromia
12538.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils engorged with multiple intracellular oval yeast forms, each surrounded by a clear halo, together with elongated pseudohyphal forms and an extracellular chain of budding yeasts. The neutrophils show toxic granulation and vacuolation. Platelets are reduced and red cells are mildly hypochromic. Findings are consistent with fungemia due to Candida species, in keeping with the reported Candida albicans line-related sepsis; detection on a routine smear indicates a high organism burden.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are smaller (2-4 µm), uniform, with narrow-based budding at most and never form pseudohyphae.
Malassezia forms smaller yeasts with broad-based collarette budding in patients receiving lipid infusions and does not form true pseudohyphal chains in blood.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by binary fission with a central septum rather than budding.

ddx.dx: Bacterial rods (e.g., Clostridium or Bacillus) in neutrophils
ddx.vs: Bacteria are much smaller and slender, without the oval budding cells and clear halos of yeast.

10938.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有多顆漿細胞（偏心核、深藍胞質、核旁淡區），其中一顆大型漿細胞胞質內有淡藍色、邊界清楚的圓球狀包涵體（Russell body），位於核上方，提示漿細胞腫瘤中的免疫球蛋白堆積。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Large atypical plasma cell containing a sharply defined round pale blue-gray globular inclusion (Russell body)
Some plasma cells enlarged with prominent nucleoli and irregular cytoplasmic outlines
Background of residual myeloid precursors, segmented neutrophils and erythroid precursors
Scattered red cells with a hemodiluted, crowded aspirate background
10938.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased plasma cells, including mature forms with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof, as well as enlarged atypical forms with nucleoli. One large plasma cell contains a round, homogeneous, pale blue-gray cytoplasmic inclusion consistent with a Russell body. Residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors are present. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with Russell body formation; plasma cell percentage, clonality studies and serum/urine protein electrophoresis are required for classification as plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, lack nucleoli and atypia, usually constitute under 10% of cells and are polytypic, although Russell bodies themselves can occur in reactive states.
Mott cells contain multiple smaller Russell bodies filling the cytoplasm like a bunch of grapes, whereas this cell has a single large globule.
Macrophages contain phagocytosed red cells or nuclear debris with abundant pale cytoplasm and a central nucleus, not a homogeneous immunoglobulin globule in a basophilic plasma cell.

3962.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片經白血球鹼性磷酸酶（LAP）染色，嗜中性球核呈紅色、胞質有藍色顆粒沉積，圖中以數字 1–4 標示不同強度，示範依陽性顆粒多寡給予 0–4 分的計分方式。
features: Cytochemical stain with red nuclear counterstain and blue granular cytoplasmic reaction product in neutrophils
Cell 1: sparse faint blue granules (score 1)
Cells 2 and 3: moderate granular positivity with more cytoplasmic coverage (scores 2-3)
Cells 4: dense blue reaction product filling the cytoplasm and partly obscuring the nucleus (score 4)
Unstained yellow-tan erythrocyte background
3962.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained for leukocyte alkaline phosphatase shows segmented neutrophils with red counterstained nuclei and variable blue granular cytoplasmic reaction product. Labeled cells illustrate the grading scale, from sparse faint granules (1) through moderate staining (2-3) to intense reaction product filling the cytoplasm (4). The LAP score is calculated by grading 100 consecutive segmented neutrophils and bands from 0 to 4 and summing the results (range 0-400). This image demonstrates the scoring method; a high score favors a leukemoid reaction or polycythemia vera, whereas a low score favors CML.

ddx.vs: In CML most neutrophils would be grade 0-1 with little or no blue reaction product, unlike the grade 3-4 cells labeled here.

ddx.dx: Myeloperoxidase or Sudan black B cytochemistry
ddx.vs: Those stains mark primary granules in blasts and granulocytes and are not graded per cell like LAP.
Toxic granules are dark purple on Romanowsky stain and are not a cytochemical enzyme reaction.

1402.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫組化中，大多數中小型未成熟細胞的細胞質與細胞膜呈棕色陽性，並排列在帶流線狀纖維化的間質中，符合巨核細胞系標記（如 CD61/CD42b）陽性的母細胞浸潤。
features: Diffuse cytoplasmic and membranous brown staining in a large proportion of small to medium-sized cells
Positive cells lack the size and lobulated nuclei of mature megakaryocytes
Negative cells show oval to elongated nuclei with hematoxylin counterstain
Streaming, fascicular arrangement suggesting stromal fibrosis
Few fat spaces; marrow largely replaced
1402.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy immunohistochemistry (megakaryocytic marker, presumably CD61 or CD42b; antibody not specified in the image) shows strong cytoplasmic and membranous staining in numerous small to medium-sized mononuclear cells. The positive cells are arranged in a streaming pattern within a fibrotic-appearing stroma and are far smaller than mature megakaryocytes. Findings support megakaryocytic lineage of an immature infiltrate, consistent with acute megakaryoblastic leukemia in the appropriate context of blast count and morphology.

ddx.dx: Primary myelofibrosis / MPN with clustered megakaryocytes
ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes stain as large, mature, often atypical cells, whereas here the positive cells are small immature forms.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or sarcoma with fibrosis
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor is negative for CD61/CD42b and positive for keratin or other lineage markers.
Shows dysplastic micromegakaryocytes but fewer than 20% blasts; CD34 and blast enumeration separate it from AMKL.
Features trilineage proliferation with blasts that are not predominantly megakaryoblastic, requiring a panel of lineage stains.

1914.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨大的巨核細胞，胞質豐富呈細顆粒狀、核分葉位於右下，胞質內可見一顆完整的小細胞（淡粉紅色卵圓形），位於胞質中而非被破壞，即細胞穿越現象（emperipolesis）。
features: Very large megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular lilac cytoplasm
Multilobated, dense nucleus positioned eccentrically at the lower right of the cell
An intact small cell (pale pink oval body) lying within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm, without evidence of degradation
Surrounding small hematopoietic cells and red cell aggregates in a thick aspirate background
No dysplastic hypolobated or separated nuclear lobes evident
1914.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and an eccentric lobulated nucleus. An intact small cell is present within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm, consistent with emperipolesis, in which neutrophils or other hematopoietic cells transit through the megakaryocyte demarcation membrane system without being destroyed. The engulfed cell's lineage cannot be determined with certainty at this resolution. Emperipolesis is a nonspecific finding that may be increased in reactive states, myeloproliferative neoplasms (notably primary myelofibrosis) and other conditions with megakaryocytic hyperplasia.

ddx.vs: Macrophages have a single oval nucleus and the ingested cells are enclosed in vacuoles and degraded, whereas in emperipolesis the host is a megakaryocyte and the passenger cell is intact.
Host cells are S100-positive histiocytes in lymph node sinuses containing intact lymphocytes, not megakaryocytes.
A cell lying on top of the megakaryocyte sits in a different focal plane and is not surrounded by cytoplasm.

1210.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量中型單核細胞，核呈卵圓至腎形（bean-shaped）、染色質均勻細緻，細胞質淡藍而邊界模糊、細胞彼此間距規則（fried-egg 樣），取代正常造血細胞，符合毛細胞白血病浸潤。
features: Sheets of medium-sized mononuclear cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
Moderate N:C ratio with ill-defined, pale grey-blue cytoplasm
Oval, reniform (bean-shaped) and occasionally indented nuclei
Homogeneous, finely stippled chromatin with absent or inconspicuous nucleoli
Cells appear evenly spaced; hair-like projections not well resolved in this thick aspirate
Few residual erythroid precursors and neutrophils; numerous fat spaces
1210.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and dominated by medium-sized mononuclear cells with oval to bean-shaped nuclei, homogeneous finely granular chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate pale grey-blue cytoplasm with indistinct borders. The cells are evenly spaced and largely replace the normal hematopoietic elements, with only scattered residual erythroid precursors and granulocytes. Cytoplasmic hair-like projections are not well appreciated in this thick area of the aspirate, so confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: SMZL cells are smaller with clumped chromatin and polar villi and are CD103-/CD25-/annexin A1-negative, in contrast to hairy cells.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles, and express CD14 and nonspecific esterase rather than B-cell markers.
Mast cells have round to spindled nuclei with abundant metachromatic granules and express CD117/tryptase, whereas hairy cells are agranular B cells.
HCL-v cells have a prominent nucleolus and lack CD25 and annexin A1, and are BRAF V600E-negative.

1146.recognize_zh: 數個大型單核球系細胞核呈摺疊、腎形或不規則扭曲，染色質細緻，灰藍色細胞質有空泡與偽足樣突起，符合異常（發育不良）單核球／前單核球，見於急性單核球性白血病。
features: Large monocytic cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Nuclei folded, reniform, indented or irregularly contoured
Fine, lacy chromatin with occasional small nucleoli
Cytoplasmic vacuoles and pseudopod-like blebs; fine azurophilic granules in some cells
Some cells with rounder nuclei and higher N:C ratio (monoblast/promonocyte-like)
1146.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of large monocytic cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing vacuoles and fine granules, with irregular cytoplasmic blebs. Nuclei are folded, reniform or irregularly contoured with delicate chromatin and occasional small nucleoli; a few cells have rounder nuclei with higher nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. These cells show immature and atypical features beyond those of normal mature monocytes. Findings are suggestive of promonocytes/abnormal monocytes of acute monocytic leukemia; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry are recommended.

ddx.vs: Mature monocytes have more condensed chromatin, no nucleoli and deeply folded nuclei, whereas promonocytes have delicate chromatin with subtle folding and nucleoli.
CMML has mostly mature monocytes with <20% blasts/promonocytes in blood and marrow, whereas acute monocytic leukemia has ≥20% blasts including promonocytes.
Microgranular APL cells have bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei, are strongly MPO positive and harbor PML::RARA, unlike NSE-positive, MPO-weak monocytic cells.
Reactive lymphocytes have mature clumped chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells, without vacuolated gray cytoplasm and folded nuclei.

1082.recognize_zh: 中央大型漿細胞核偏位、細胞質嗜鹼性，整個細胞質布滿細小紅紫色嗜天青顆粒，周圍數顆漿細胞亦有類似顆粒，即Snapper-Schneid顆粒；需與前骨髓細胞區分。
features: Large plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus, coarse chromatin, and abundant basophilic cytoplasm
Numerous fine to coarse reddish-purple azurophilic granules scattered throughout the cytoplasm (Snapper-Schneid granules)
Neighboring plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and similar granular cytoplasm
No Auer rods; granules do not obscure the nucleus
Background with segmented neutrophil, small lymphocyte, and red cells
1082.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clock-face to coarse chromatin, and abundant basophilic cytoplasm. Several cells, including a large central plasma cell, contain numerous reddish-purple azurophilic cytoplasmic granules (Snapper-Schneid granules). Neutrophils, lymphocytes, and red cells are present in the background. Findings represent azurophilic granulation in plasma cells, which is described in plasma cell neoplasms; quantitation and clonality assessment are needed for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Promyelocytes have a paler perinuclear Golgi zone, finer chromatin with nucleoli, and MPO-positive primary granules, whereas granulated plasma cells retain clock-face chromatin and CD138 positivity.
Mast cells have round central nuclei with dense purple-black metachromatic granules that often obscure the nucleus and are tryptase/CD117 positive.
Crystal-storing plasma cells show needle- or rod-shaped crystals rather than round azurophilic granules.

4218.recognize_zh: 高倍可見真皮淺層血管周圍一團中型淋巴球，細胞核不規則、染色質較開、比周圍小淋巴球大，屬異型 T 細胞浸潤；配合 HTLV-1 陽性即支持 ATLL 侵犯皮膚。
features: Well-circumscribed perivascular aggregate of medium-sized lymphoid cells in the superficial dermis
Nuclei larger than admixed small lymphocytes, with irregular/indented contours and vesicular chromatin
Small inconspicuous nucleoli; scant cytoplasm
Scattered small mature lymphocytes and occasional melanophages in the papillary dermis
Overlying epidermis with compact orthokeratosis; no Pautrier-type microabscess evident in this field
4218.describe_en: H&E section of skin at higher power shows a superficial dermal perivascular aggregate of atypical medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours, open chromatin and scant cytoplasm, admixed with a few small mature lymphocytes. Scattered pigment-laden macrophages are present in the papillary dermis. The overlying epidermis shows compact orthokeratosis without conspicuous epidermotropism in this field. Findings are consistent with a cutaneous atypical T-cell infiltrate and, with HTLV-1 positivity, with involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MF typically shows prominent epidermotropism with cerebriform cells in Pautrier microabscesses; overlap with ATLL is resolved by HTLV-1 testing.
T-PLL cells are small-to-medium with a single visible nucleolus and are TCL1-positive, CD25-negative.
Reactive perivascular lymphocytes are small and round without the nuclear enlargement and irregularity seen here.

4090.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色中，大型腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫、強烈的細胞膜環狀陽性，勾勒出大而形狀不規則的細胞輪廓；圖上未標示抗體名稱，需搭配 CD20/PAX5 與 CD30 染色結果判讀。
features: Diffuse sheet of large tumor cells with strong membranous staining
Crisp circumferential membrane outlines with some cytoplasmic/dot-like accentuation
Large, pleomorphic unstained nuclei with vesicular chromatin in hematoxylin counterstain
Scattered larger cells with abundant cytoplasm
Nearly all neoplastic cells positive; antibody not specified in image
4090.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows a diffuse population of large pleomorphic cells with strong, circumferential membranous staining and focal cytoplasmic accentuation in virtually all tumor cells. The specific antibody is not indicated on the image; the staining pattern would fit either a pan-B-cell marker such as CD20 or CD30. In the context of an anaplastic large B-cell morphology, findings support diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant, and should be interpreted with the full panel.

ddx.vs: ALCL is uniformly CD30+ with membrane and Golgi staining but negative for CD20/PAX5 and positive for T-cell or cytotoxic markers.
cHL shows CD30/CD15 staining of scattered Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells rather than diffuse sheets, with weak PAX5 and CD20 negativity.
PMBL has sclerosis with clear-cell morphology, often weak CD30, and CD23/MAL positivity in a mediastinal mass.

4154.recognize_zh: 淋巴結被瀰漫、單調一致的小到中型淋巴球取代，核稍不規則、胞質稀少，缺乏大型中心母細胞與免疫母細胞，間有少數淡粉紅色組織球與玻璃樣小血管，這種單形性表現是套細胞淋巴瘤的線索。
features: Diffuse effacement by monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Slightly irregular to round nuclei with dispersed-to-condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant cytoplasm; absence of admixed large transformed cells
Scattered pale epithelioid histiocytes (pink histiocytes)
Small hyalinized vessels; vague nodularity with darker zones
4154.describe_en: Lymph node section shows diffuse to vaguely nodular effacement by a monotonous population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with slightly irregular nuclei, dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Large transformed cells and proliferation centers are not identified. Scattered pink histiocytes and small hyalinized vessels are present. Findings are suggestive of mantle cell lymphoma; confirmation with CD20, CD5, cyclin D1 and SOX11 immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: SLL has pale proliferation centers with prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts and is CD23+/LEF1+, cyclin D1-negative.
FL shows back-to-back neoplastic follicles with centrocytes and admixed centroblasts and is CD10+/BCL6+.
MZL cells have more abundant pale cytoplasm and plasmacytic differentiation and are CD5-/cyclin D1-negative.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma has finer blastic chromatin, a high mitotic rate and TdT positivity.

3578.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒球系前驅細胞出現多種異常：一顆前骨髓細胞／骨髓細胞細胞質有多個清楚空泡，數顆骨髓細胞顆粒分佈不均、部分區域淡染無顆粒；右側一顆成熟顆粒球只有兩個圓形核葉相連（假性 Pelger-Huët，pince-nez 樣）。這些綜合起來是顆粒球生成異常（dysgranulopoiesis）。
features: Cluster of granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes and myelocytes) with uneven, patchy granulation and agranular cytoplasmic areas
Promyelocyte/myelocyte with multiple discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Mature granulocyte with a bilobed, pince-nez nucleus and hypogranular cytoplasm (pseudo-Pelger-Huët)
Some precursors with large nuclei showing nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony
An elongated dense cell (likely a smeared/degenerating cell) and a hyposegmented neutrophil at the lower left
3578.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of granulocytic precursors with dysplastic features. Several promyelocytes and myelocytes show uneven granulation with agranular cytoplasmic zones, and one contains multiple discrete clear vacuoles. A mature granulocyte displays a bilobed pince-nez nucleus with hypogranular cytoplasm, consistent with a pseudo-Pelger-Huët cell, and some precursors show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. Findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis; correlation with the proportion of dysplastic cells, blast count, cytogenetics and exclusion of reactive causes (drugs, alcohol, copper deficiency) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Inherited Pelger-Huët affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation, whereas pseudo-Pelger cells here coexist with hypogranularity and other dysplastic precursors.
Vacuolated myeloid and erythroid precursors can be seen with alcohol or copper deficiency; distinction requires clinical history, copper/zinc levels and absence of clonal abnormalities.
APL shows sheets of hypergranular abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles, rather than a maturing granulocytic series with scattered dysplasia.

3642.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中幾乎全是各階段的顆粒球（骨髓細胞、帶狀核、分葉核），有深藍細胞質與濃縮圓核的紅血球母細胞（erythroid precursors）非常少見，M:E 比明顯升高，提示紅血球系低下。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils)
Marked paucity of erythroid precursors; few cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm or dense round nuclei
Occasional eosinophilic precursors with orange granules
Granulocytic maturation appears orderly without an obvious blast excess
No giant proerythroblasts with viral inclusions seen in this field
3642.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cellular particles composed predominantly of maturing granulocytic cells, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils with orderly maturation. Erythroid precursors are markedly reduced, resulting in a high myeloid-to-erythroid ratio. No increase in blasts and no giant pronormoblasts are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with erythroid hypoplasia; correlation with reticulocyte count, parvovirus B19 studies, drug history and thymoma/LGL evaluation is suggested.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19-associated pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: Shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions and vacuolated blue cytoplasm, which are not seen here.

Also raises the M:E ratio but through expansion of granulocytes with preserved absolute erythropoiesis, which requires cellularity assessment on the biopsy and CBC/reticulocyte correlation to separate.
Would show dysplasia in residual lineages (hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, micromegakaryocytes), which is not evident in this field.

3706.recognize_zh: H&E 切片中正常結構被成片的中等大小、核卵圓至略梭形、染色質細緻並有小核仁的不成熟細胞取代，呈流水狀排列，其間夾雜嗜酸性顆粒的骨髓前驅細胞，符合移植後復發的 AML 浸潤；需免疫染色證實。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-sized immature cells effacing the background architecture
Oval to slightly elongated nuclei with fine dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm; cells arranged in vague streaming fascicles
Scattered admixed maturing myeloid cells including eosinophilic precursors with bright pink granules
Occasional mitotic and apoptotic figures
Morphology alone is nonspecific; lineage cannot be established without immunostains
3706.describe_en: Section shows a diffuse, hypercellular infiltrate of medium-sized immature mononuclear cells arranged in sheets and vague streaming fascicles. The cells have oval to slightly elongated nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm; scattered eosinophilic precursors and apoptotic bodies are admixed. It is not possible to determine from this image alone whether this is marrow or extramedullary tissue, and the spindled growth pattern can mimic a non-hematopoietic neoplasm. In the context of prior acute myeloid leukemia and stem cell transplantation, findings are suggestive of recurrent AML (myeloid sarcoma or marrow relapse), to be confirmed by immunohistochemistry (CD34, CD117, MPO, lysozyme, CD68) and chimerism studies.

ddx.vs: Composed of lymphoid cells (often large B cells, CD20+/EBER+) rather than MPO/CD117/CD34-positive myeloid blasts with admixed eosinophilic precursors.
Cells usually have vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli and are CD20/PAX5 positive and MPO negative, requiring immunohistochemistry to separate.
Shows cohesive fascicles of cells with keratin/desmin/S100 or other lineage markers and lacks CD45 and myeloid markers, whereas myeloid sarcoma is CD43/CD45 and MPO or CD68 positive.

3514.recognize_zh: 中央有一顆大型未成熟細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，細胞質深藍色且無顆粒；背景可見大量大型、低顆粒的血小板，這種血小板異常合併芽細胞的組合是 AML 伴 inv(3)/t(3;3) 的提示。
features: Large immature cell with round nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin, and indistinct nucleoli
Moderate rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Background of numerous large and giant platelets, many hypogranular
Overlapping red cells in a thick area of the smear
3514.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large immature mononuclear cell with a round nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin, and a moderate rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm, consistent with a blast; the basophilic cytoplasm raises the possibility of megakaryocytic or erythroid lineage, which cannot be determined morphologically. The background contains numerous large and hypogranular platelets. Red cells overlap in this thicker area. In the appropriate context, findings are suggestive of AML with inv(3)/t(3;3) (GATA2/MECOM), which requires cytogenetic confirmation.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts often show cytoplasmic blebs and require CD41/CD61 flow cytometry or IHC; inv(3) is defined cytogenetically rather than by lineage.
Plasmacytoid cells have an eccentric nucleus with clumped chromatin and a perinuclear hof, unlike the fine blast chromatin here.
Pronormoblasts also have deep blue cytoplasm but show a prominent nucleolus and are rare in blood outside of severe stress erythropoiesis; flow (CD71, glycophorin) separates them.

3194.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結結構保留，濾泡之間的竇被大片淡染的組織球擴張成蒼白區域，與深藍色濾泡形成明暗交錯、被膜增厚纖維化，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病的竇擴張樣式。
features: Low-power lymph node with preserved but distorted architecture
Pale-staining, markedly dilated sinuses filled with histiocytes separating dark lymphoid follicles
Scattered residual follicles, some with germinal centers
Thickened fibrotic capsule and fibrous bands at the periphery
Cellular detail (emperipolesis) not assessable at this magnification
3194.describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows preserved but distorted architecture with marked sinus dilation. The sinuses are expanded by pale-staining sheets of histiocytes, producing a light-and-dark pattern against residual dark-staining lymphoid follicles. The capsule is thickened and fibrotic. Higher power is required to assess emperipolesis. Findings are suggestive of sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy (Rosai-Dorfman disease), pending S100 immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Reactive sinus histiocytosis rarely produces such massive sinus distension with capsular fibrosis and lacks large S100-positive histiocytes with emperipolesis.
LCH also involves sinuses but shows grooved nuclei, eosinophils and necrosis with CD1a/langerin positivity.
Metastatic carcinoma forms cohesive atypical epithelial nests that are keratin positive rather than bland histiocytes.

ddx.dx: Lymphadenopathy in Whipple disease or mycobacterial infection
ddx.vs: Infectious histiocytic lesions show foamy PAS-positive or AFB-positive histiocytes or granulomas rather than S100-positive emperipolesis-rich cells.

3450.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆橢圓形紅血球充滿許多均勻分布的深紫色粗點，另有一顆偏藍大細胞帶細點彩，符合嗜鹼性點彩；周圍紅血球大多正常。
features: Central oval red cell packed with coarse, discrete dark purple granules throughout the cytoplasm
A larger polychromatophilic red cell (lower center) with finer, diffuse stippling
A cell at lower left shows faint fine stippling around central pallor
Background red cells normocytic, normochromic with central pallor; occasional small refractile dot artifacts
Scattered small platelets; no leukocytes in field
3450.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a background of normocytic, normochromic red cells. A central elliptical red cell contains numerous coarse, evenly dispersed basophilic granules, and additional polychromatophilic cells show finer diffuse stippling. No intraerythrocytic parasites are identified. Findings are consistent with coarse basophilic stippling; correlation with blood lead level and hemoglobin studies is suggested.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are sparse, peripherally clustered and iron-positive, while stippling here fills the cell diffusely.
Maurer clefts accompany visible ring forms and appear as irregular comma-shaped red dots, not uniform blue granules without a parasite.
An overlying platelet is a single granular body with a pale hyalomere rather than many discrete granules within the red cell.

3322.recognize_zh: 高倍率 H&E 脾臟紅髓內充滿單一形態的中型細胞，細胞核卵圓至腎形凹陷、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，細胞質中等淡染，並夾雜大量紅血球填塞的紅血球湖；這種紅髓瀰漫性侵犯的中型淋巴樣細胞符合毛細胞白血病變異型。
features: Monotonous infiltrate of intermediate-sized cells expanding the red pulp
Oval to indented or reniform nuclei with fine to vesicular chromatin
Small but distinct nucleoli in many cells
Moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders
Abundant extravasated red cells filling cords and sinuses (blood lakes)
Rare mitoses; no necrosis
3322.describe_en: Section of spleen at high power shows the red pulp diffusely infiltrated by a monotonous population of intermediate-sized lymphoid cells. The cells have oval to indented nuclei with fine to vesicular chromatin, small distinct nucleoli, and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Abundant extravasated red cells fill the cords and form blood lakes between tumor cells, and mitotic activity is low. Findings are consistent with splenic red pulp involvement by a B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli, in context hairy cell leukemia variant, pending immunohistochemical confirmation.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL cells have bland nuclei without conspicuous nucleoli and a fried-egg appearance, and are annexin A1+, CD25+ and BRAF V600E+.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells are smaller and more monomorphic with inconspicuous nucleoli, and are CD103- and CD25-.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving spleen
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular nuclei and a high Ki-67, typically forming tumor nodules rather than diffuse red pulp infiltration.
HSTCL shows intrasinusoidal CD3+, CD5-, TCR gamma-delta+ cells without B-cell markers.

3258.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一條由深染、拉長核組成的線狀血管／基質片段，旁邊沿著排列一群圓形深染核的小細胞，符合漿細胞沿竇狀血管分布的常見樣式；但本圖染色偏深，漿細胞的偏心核與 hof 不易逐顆確認。
features: Linear stromal-vascular (capillary/sinusoidal) fragment with dark, elongated, overlapping nuclei in a bluish matrix
Numerous small cells with round, dense, dark nuclei clustered along the vessel
Some adjacent cells with round nuclei and moderate purple cytoplasm, compatible with plasma cells
Scattered mature neutrophils, bands and erythroid precursors in the surrounding field
Dense staining and overlap limit assessment of perinuclear hof and chromatin pattern
3258.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a linear stromal-vascular fragment composed of elongated dark nuclei, along which numerous small round-nucleated cells are aligned. Some of the adjacent cells have moderate purple cytoplasm compatible with plasma cells, while scattered neutrophils, bands and erythroid precursors are present in the background. Heavy staining and cell overlap limit confident identification of individual plasma cells at this magnification. The pattern is compatible with the normal perivascular (perisinusoidal) distribution of marrow plasma cells; CD138 immunostaining on the core biopsy best demonstrates this arrangement.

ddx.vs: Myeloma shows increased plasma cells forming interstitial clusters or sheets away from vessels, often with atypical or immature forms and light-chain restriction.
Metastatic carcinoma forms cohesive clusters of large atypical cells with prominent nucleoli rather than a vessel lined by small bland round cells.
Lymphoid aggregates are rounded collections of small lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm and are not arranged linearly along a capillary.

3066.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片（cytospin）上成群的大型芽細胞，核質比高、核型折疊或腎形、染色質細緻並有明顯核仁，細胞質藍灰且有小空泡，符合中樞神經侵犯的急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Large blasts, roughly 3-4 times the diameter of an RBC, in a crowded cohesive-appearing aggregate (cytospin artifact)
Moderate to high N:C ratio with folded, indented, or reniform nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with one or more prominent nucleoli
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm with scattered small vacuoles and fine granularity; no Auer rods seen
Rare RBC in background; no mature lymphocytes or neutrophils in this field
3066.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a markedly cellular specimen composed of sheets of large atypical mononuclear cells. The cells have moderate amounts of gray-blue, focally vacuolated cytoplasm, folded to reniform nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and prominent nucleoli. No Auer rods are identified in this field, and normal CSF lymphocytes and monocytes are not seen. Findings are consistent with involvement of the CSF by acute myeloid leukemia, with monocytoid blast morphology; flow cytometry or cytochemistry is needed for confirmation of lineage.

ddx.dx: CNS involvement by B- or T-lymphoblastic leukemia
ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are smaller with scant agranular cytoplasm and round nuclei, whereas these blasts have more abundant vacuolated gray cytoplasm and folded nuclei; flow cytometry confirms lineage.
Lymphoma cells have basophilic cytoplasm and coarser chromatin with lymphoid immunophenotype (CD19/CD20+), whereas myeloid blasts express CD33/CD13/CD64 and lack B-cell markers.
Reactive monocytes have condensed lacy chromatin without prominent nucleoli and occur singly among lymphocytes, not as a monotonous sheet of nucleolated cells.
Carcinoma cells form true 3D cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and are keratin-positive and CD45-negative, unlike these dyscohesive CD45-positive blasts.

2810.recognize_zh: 成片小到中型母細胞，核圓或略有凹陷、染色質均勻細緻、細胞質極少且無顆粒，有些細胞帶手鏡狀尾巴，外觀均一，符合前驅 B 細胞淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Sheets of small-to-medium blasts, about 1.5-2 times a red cell
High N:C ratio with scant pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round to oval or slightly indented nuclei; one cell with a tapered hand-mirror cytoplasmic tail
Fine, homogeneous chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules; few residual normal cells
2810.describe_en: The smear shows a monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts with high N:C ratios, round to indented nuclei, fine homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. Occasional cells have hand-mirror cytoplasmic projections. Auer rods and granules are absent, and normal hematopoietic elements are sparse. The morphology favors lymphoblasts; findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia, to be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, CD22, TdT, CD34) and genetic studies.

ddx.vs: T-ALL blasts look the same and are distinguished by cytoplasmic CD3 expression without B-lineage markers.
AML-M0 blasts are also agranular but are MPO-negative by cytochemistry yet MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117-positive by flow and TdT-negative or weak.
Hematogones show a continuous maturation spectrum by flow (CD34 to CD20) rather than a monotonous, blocked immature population.
Blastoid MCL cells are TdT/CD34-negative, surface Ig-positive and cyclin D1-positive.

2746.recognize_zh: 抹片中大量中小型淋巴細胞，核圓或略不規則、染色質中度凝集，細胞質少而偏嗜鹼性並有小突起（blebs），混雜少數顆粒球系細胞；這種以成熟外觀、帶細胞質突起的淋巴細胞為主的族群，符合 T 前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）侵犯。
features: Predominant population of small to intermediate lymphoid cells
High N:C ratio with scant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm showing small cytoplasmic protrusions/blebs
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent at this resolution
Admixed band neutrophils, a granulated precursor and an eosinophilic myelocyte
One larger cell with abundant granular cytoplasm (likely a promyelocyte)
2746.describe_en: Smear (bone marrow aspirate appearance given admixed granulocytic precursors) shows a predominant population of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to mildly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm with small cytoplasmic blebs. Residual granulocytic elements, including bands, an eosinophilic myelocyte and a probable promyelocyte, are present. Nucleoli are not well resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with involvement by T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation requires flow cytometry (CD3+, CD7 strong, CD4+ or CD4/CD8 co-expression) and TCL1A rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have soccer-ball clumped chromatin without cytoplasmic blebs and are CD5+/CD23+/CD200+ B cells rather than TCL1-positive T cells.
Sezary cells have cerebriform, deeply grooved nuclei and are CD4+/CD7-negative, whereas T-PLL cells have round nuclei with blebs and strong CD7.
ATLL shows polylobated 'flower' nuclei, CD25 expression and HTLV-1 serology positivity.

ddx.dx: B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (now B-PLL/splenic B-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus and more cytoplasm, and express B-cell antigens.

2682.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向淋巴球核旁一條細長、不著色的透明棒狀空隙，這是細胞質內結晶（多為免疫球蛋白結晶）的負像；細胞核染色質濃縮、細胞質少，屬成熟型惡性淋巴球。
features: Small-to-medium lymphocyte with high N:C ratio
Oval nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin and pale streaks
Scant pale blue cytoplasm
Thin, straight, colorless rod-shaped crystalline inclusion along the nuclear edge (arrow)
Surrounding red cells with mild poikilocytosis; enlarged, pixelated image
2682.describe_en: High-power, digitally enlarged view of a peripheral blood smear shows a mature-appearing lymphocyte with a high N:C ratio, coarsely clumped chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm. A slender, straight, unstained rod-like inclusion lies in the cytoplasm immediately adjacent to the nucleus, as indicated by the arrow. No granules or Auer rods are present. Findings are consistent with a crystalline (likely immunoglobulin) inclusion in a neoplastic lymphocyte, as described in CLL and other low-grade B-cell lymphomas; the pixelated enlargement limits fine detail, so correlation with other cells and immunophenotyping is needed.

ddx.vs: Auer rods are pink-purple staining needles in blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli, whereas these crystals are colorless negative images in mature lymphocytes.
Artifact crosses cell borders or background, while a true crystal is confined to the cytoplasm and recurs in multiple lymphoid cells.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell with crystalline inclusions (myeloma/Fanconi syndrome)
ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof, unlike this scant-cytoplasm lymphocyte.

2298.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大型細胞具有豐富灰藍色細胞質、偶有細顆粒與偽足樣邊緣，核為圓形到腎形或摺疊、染色質細緻如花邊，符合單核母細胞與前單核球為主的急性單核球性白血病。
features: Large cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, some with fine azurophilic granules and irregular pseudopod-like borders
Round, oval to reniform or folded nuclei
Delicate lacy chromatin with occasional nucleoli
Low to moderate N:C ratio compared with myeloblasts
Monotonous population with few maturing granulocytes; dense red cell background
2298.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a monotonous population of large cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, fine azurophilic granules in some cells and irregular cytoplasmic borders. Nuclei are round to reniform or folded with delicate lacy chromatin and occasional nucleoli. Maturing neutrophil lineage cells are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b) are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Requires at least 20% neutrophil lineage cells with MPO-positive blasts, whereas this field is dominated by monocytic cells.
Microgranular APL has bilobed or butterfly nuclei, strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA, whereas monoblasts are MPO weak/negative and NSE positive.
In CMML monocytes are mature with condensed chromatin and blasts plus promonocytes are below 20%.
