2106.recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球核呈未完全分葉的帶狀形，胞質內顆粒增多，在核上緣胞質內可見一小片淡藍色斑塊（Döhle body）；周圍紅血球有折光乾燥假影，勿與包涵體混淆。
features: Neutrophil with hyposegmented, band-like nucleus and clumped chromatin
Small pale blue cytoplasmic patch near the upper nuclear border (Döhle body)
Increased fine to coarse purple cytoplasmic granulation
Several red cells with refractile drying artifact mimicking inclusions
Few platelets in background
2106.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a neutrophil with a hyposegmented, band-like nucleus, increased cytoplasmic granulation, and a small pale blue agranular cytoplasmic patch consistent with a Döhle body. Several red cells display refractile drying artifact, which should not be mistaken for inclusions or parasites. Findings are consistent with reactive toxic neutrophil changes with a left shift.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions affect most neutrophils and occur with macrothrombocytopenia, without toxic granulation.
Drying artifacts are sharply refractile and colorless, unlike the blue homogeneous Döhle body within neutrophil cytoplasm.
Dysplastic neutrophils show decreased granules, whereas this cell shows increased granulation.

2042.recognize_zh: 四顆大型細胞的細胞質塞滿粗大紫紅色顆粒，把核的輪廓都遮住了；右側一顆核呈雙葉、中間凹陷（bilobed / butterfly nucleus），部分細胞有淡藍色細胞質伸出，這是典型顆粒過多型前骨髓細胞（hypergranular promyelocyte）。
features: Large cells, roughly 2-3 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Cytoplasm densely packed with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules that obscure nuclear detail
Nuclear outline visible as bilobed/folded (butterfly-like) in at least one cell
Some cells show a pale, agranular basophilic cytoplasmic bleb or tail
No distinct Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) are resolved in this field
Background of red cells with drying artifact; no mature neutrophils in field
2042.describe_en: Smear shows several large abnormal cells amid red cells. The cells have abundant cytoplasm so densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules that the nuclear outline is largely obscured; where visible, nuclei are folded to bilobed. A few cells have a pale agranular cytoplasmic protrusion. Auer rod bundles are not clearly resolved in this field. Findings are consistent with abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation of PML::RARA is indicated.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocytes (e.g., G-CSF effect, marrow recovery)
ddx.vs: Normal promyelocytes have a round eccentric nucleus with a visible Golgi hof and granules that do not obscure the nucleus, and they occur with orderly maturation rather than as a dominant population.
Blasts in t(8;21) show fewer granules, a single long Auer rod, perinuclear hof and salmon-colored granules, without the bilobed, granule-obscured nuclei of APL.
The microgranular variant shows bilobed nuclei with sparse or dust-like granules, whereas these cells are overtly packed with coarse granules; both require PML::RARA confirmation.

Monoblasts/promonocytes have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and delicate folded nuclei with lacy chromatin, and are MPO weak with nonspecific esterase positivity, unlike strongly MPO-positive APL cells.

1850.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有大量單核樣胚細胞與前單核球，箭頭所指細胞的細胞質含粗大深紫色顆粒，混合嗜伊紅與嗜鹼性染色特性（abnormal eosinophils），右側另見一顆布滿深色粗顆粒的細胞，符合 inv(16) AML 的異常嗜伊紅球。
features: Increased blasts and promonocytes with folded, indented nuclei and fine chromatin
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, some with fine granules
Abnormal eosinophils with large dark purple (basophilic-staining) granules admixed with eosinophilic granules (arrows)
A cell densely packed with coarse dark granules at right
Paucity of maturing neutrophils
1850.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular population dominated by blasts and promonocytes with folded or indented nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm. Scattered abnormal eosinophils contain large, dark purple basophilic-staining granules mixed with eosinophilic granules (arrows). Maturing neutrophils are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, suggestive of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22); CBFB-MYH11.

ddx.vs: AMML NOS lacks the abnormal eosinophils with large basophilic granules and is negative for CBFB-MYH11.
Basophilic blasts have metachromatic granules without eosinophilic granules and are CD123/CD203c positive, whereas inv(16) abnormal eosinophils are chloroacetate esterase positive.
t(8;21) AML shows large blasts with a single long Auer rod, salmon-colored cytoplasm and maturing neutrophils with dysplasia rather than monocytic differentiation with abnormal eosinophils.

1786.recognize_zh: 厚區周邊血中一顆核折疊的單核球（或活化吞噬細胞），箭頭所指為細胞質內一個小圓形、外圍有透亮暈圈的酵母菌樣包涵體，暈圈代表莢膜或收縮空隙，提示被吞噬的真菌（此病例為隱球菌 Cryptococcus），但光憑抹片型態無法確定菌種。
features: Monocyte/activated phagocyte with folded, irregular nucleus and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm
Arrowed small round yeast-like body within the cytoplasm surrounded by a clear halo
Additional small clear vacuole near the nucleus
Thick area of the smear with crenated, overlapping red cells out of focus
Species-level features (budding, capsule thickness) not resolvable at this magnification
1786.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a thick area with crenated overlapping red cells, shows a monocyte with a folded nucleus and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm. The cytoplasm contains a small, round, yeast-like body surrounded by a clear halo (arrow), suggestive of an encapsulated or retracted intracellular fungal organism. Narrow-based budding and capsule thickness cannot be assessed at this resolution. Findings are consistent with intracellular fungal organisms, compatible with disseminated cryptococcosis in this case; confirmation by blood culture, serum cryptococcal antigen and mucicarmine or India ink preparations is recommended.

ddx.vs: Yeasts are smaller (2-4 um), uniform, often numerous within one cell, with a crescent-shaped basophilic nucleus and a pseudocapsule halo, and are mucicarmine-negative.
Show budding yeasts with pseudohyphae and lack a clear capsular halo.
Yeast forms are elongated with a characteristic central transverse septum from fission rather than budding.
A vacuole is empty and a platelet is granular, whereas a yeast has a defined internal staining body and cell wall.

1722.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中血小板數量明顯增多且成群聚集，大小不一，箭頭所指為一顆與小淋巴球相近大小、帶紫色顆粒的巨大血小板，符合骨髓增生性腫瘤（如CML）的血小板增多症。
features: Increased numbers of platelets, many in small clumps between red cells
Marked platelet anisocytosis with a giant platelet (arrow) approaching the size of a small red cell
Giant platelet with pale blue cytoplasm and central purple granules
Some platelets appear agranular or hypogranular
Red cells show mild poikilocytosis including occasional fragmented or irregular forms
1722.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased platelets, frequently clumped, with marked variation in size including a giant platelet (arrow) and some hypogranular forms. Red cells show mild poikilocytosis. No leukocytes are present in this field, so the characteristic CML leukocytosis with basophilia cannot be assessed. Findings are consistent with thrombocytosis with platelet anisocytosis, as seen in a myeloproliferative neoplasm such as chronic myeloid leukemia; correlation with the complete blood count and BCR-ABL1 testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: ET shows similar giant and clumped platelets but lacks leukocytosis with a myelocyte bulge and basophilia, and is BCR-ABL1 negative with JAK2, CALR, or MPL mutation.
Reactive platelets are usually uniform in size and normally granular without giant or hypogranular forms.
EDTA clumping forms large aggregates at the feathered edge with a falsely low automated count, rather than true increased numbers with giant forms.
A lymphocyte has a nucleus, whereas a giant platelet has only a granulomere and hyalomere without nuclear chromatin.

1594.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆分葉核中性球，核分成4至5葉、以細絲相連，染色質粗塊狀，細胞質淡粉紅含細小顆粒；單顆五葉不足以判定過度分葉，需計數群體比例，整體符合正常中性球。
features: Mature granulocyte about twice the size of a red cell
Nucleus with four to five lobes joined by thin chromatin strands
Coarsely clumped chromatin without nucleoli
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine lilac granules, no toxic granulation or vacuoles
Background red cells with a small irregular fragment nearby and scattered platelets
1594.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with four to five nuclear lobes connected by thin filaments, coarse chromatin and pale cytoplasm with fine lilac granules. There is no toxic granulation, Döhle body or vacuolization. A single five-lobed neutrophil is within normal limits; hypersegmentation requires six or more lobes or more than 5% of neutrophils with five lobes. A small irregular fragment adjacent to the cell is of uncertain significance in isolation. Findings are consistent with a normal segmented neutrophil.

ddx.vs: True hypersegmentation shows one or more cells with six or more lobes or >5% five-lobed neutrophils, typically with macro-ovalocytes, which cannot be established from this single cell.
A band has a non-segmented U- or S-shaped nucleus of uniform width without thin filaments.
Macropolycytes are about twice the size of normal neutrophils and often tetraploid, whereas this cell is normal-sized.

122.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中充滿中至大型、細緻染色質、嗜鹼性細胞質的芽細胞（blasts）；流式細胞儀顯示同一群 CD45 弱表現的芽細胞同時有強 CD19 與強 cCD79a（B 系），另有 cMPO 陽性（骨髓系），且 cCD3 陰性，符合 WHO 的 B/骨髓系混合表現型急性白血病（MPAL）判定標準。
features: Peripheral blood smear with numerous medium-to-large blasts: high N:C ratio, round to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Blast cytoplasm is scant to moderate and deeply basophilic, some with a paler perinuclear zone; no Auer rods or obvious granules identified
Residual mature neutrophil appears small with sparse visible granules; red cells show crenation (echinocytes)
Flow cytometry: dim CD45/low side-scatter blast gate comprises 93.69% of live events; blasts are largely CD34-negative, CD117 dim/partial, CD7 largely negative, CD33+, CD13 dim/partial, CD58 bright
B-lineage markers: strong CD19 on the majority of blasts with a strongly cCD79a-positive subset (cCD22 dim/negative), CD10 negative; nTdT dim-to-moderate positive
Myeloid marker: cMPO positive, bright in a subset and dim in the cCD79a-bright population; cCD3 negative in blasts; small CD15+ subset
122.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed predominantly of medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratios, round to indented nuclei, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant basophilic cytoplasm without Auer rods; red cells show crenation. Two cytochemically stained fields show blue-black granular positivity in a granulocyte and in a large cell, with fine punctate deposits over red cells that likely represent stain artifact, so these fields are of limited interpretive value. Flow cytometry identifies a dim CD45, low side-scatter blast population (93.69% of live events) that is CD33+, CD13 dim/partial, CD117 dim/partial, CD34 largely negative, CD58 bright, and nTdT dim positive. The blasts show strong CD19 with strong cytoplasmic CD79a in a large subset, together with cytoplasmic MPO expression (bright in a subset), while cytoplasmic CD3 is negative. The accompanying WHO lineage-assignment table highlights MPO for myeloid lineage and strong CD19 plus CD79a for B lineage; findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid, pending exclusion of BCR::ABL1 and KMT2A rearrangement and of AML with myelodysplasia-related or therapy-related criteria.

ddx.dx: AML with aberrant CD19 expression (e.g., AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1)
ddx.vs: Aberrant CD19 in AML is usually weak or partial and not accompanied by strong CD79a, CD22 or CD10, so it does not meet WHO B-lineage criteria as seen here.

ddx.dx: B-lymphoblastic leukemia with myeloid antigen expression
ddx.vs: B-ALL may express CD13/CD33 but lacks MPO; the definite cMPO positivity in this blast population assigns myeloid lineage.

ddx.dx: Mixed phenotype acute leukemia with BCR::ABL1 or KMT2A rearrangement
ddx.vs: Morphology and immunophenotype overlap completely; cytogenetics/FISH or molecular testing is required, and those genetically defined MPAL subtypes take precedence over NOS.
T/myeloid MPAL requires cytoplasmic CD3 (epsilon) positivity, which is negative in these blasts.

captions: WHO 2016 lineage-assignment criteria for MPAL, with MPO and strong CD19 plus CD79a highlighted
Cytochemical stain: blue-black granular positivity in a granulocyte; fine punctate deposits over red cells likely artifact
Cytochemical stain: large cell with coarse blue-black peripheral granular positivity amid artifactual red-cell deposits
CD45 vs side scatter: dim CD45, low SSC blast gate comprising 93.69% of live events
Blast gate CD117 vs CD34: blasts largely CD34-negative with dim/partial CD117; minor CD34+ subset
Blast gate CD7 vs CD34: CD7 largely negative to partial dim
Blast gate CD13 vs CD33: CD33 positive, CD13 dim to partial
Blast gate CD123 vs CD19: strong CD19 on the majority of blasts (blue), CD123 largely negative
Blast gate cCD22 vs cCD79a: strongly cCD79a-positive subset (gate M, green) with dim/negative cCD22
Blast gate nTdT vs cMPO: cCD79a-bright blasts (green) MPO dim; separate MPO-bright subset (red); TdT dim positive
Blast gate nTdT vs CD34: TdT dim positive, CD34 mostly negative
Blast gate nTdT vs cCD3: blasts cytoplasmic CD3 negative
Ungated cMPO vs CD33: CD33+ blasts with dim-to-bright MPO; residual granulocytes MPO bright
Live gate CD36 vs CD64: heterogeneous CD64/CD36 continuum without a discrete mature monocyte population
Blast gate CD33 vs CD58: blasts uniformly CD58 bright with variable CD33
Blast gate CD15 vs CD10: CD10 negative; small CD15-positive subset (gate O)
Peripheral blood: medium-to-large blasts with basophilic cytoplasm, indented nuclei, and a small neutrophil
Peripheral blood: blasts with fine chromatin, high N:C ratio, and paler perinuclear cytoplasm; crenated red cells

58.recognize_zh: 腦組織切片中大型異型淋巴細胞呈血管周圍套袖狀（perivascular cuffing）聚集，網狀纖維染色（reticulin）在血管周圍形成同心圓層狀；IHC 為 CD20+、CD10−、BCL6+、MUM1+ 的非生發中心型，符合原發性中樞神經 DLBCL。
features: Diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular to coarse chromatin, prominent nucleoli and irregular nuclear contours
Striking angiocentric growth with tumor cells cuffing and infiltrating vessel walls (perivascular cuffing)
Numerous mitoses and apoptotic bodies; necrosis-adjacent brain parenchyma at the edge
Reticulin stain shows concentric perivascular reticulin rings splitting around vessels
IHC: CD20+, CD10-, BCL6+, MUM1+ (non-germinal center phenotype), BCL2+, c-MYC+ in a subset, high Ki-67
58.describe_en: Sections of brain show a diffusely infiltrative neoplasm composed of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli and frequent mitoses and apoptotic bodies. The tumor cells show a prominent angiocentric pattern, forming concentric cuffs around vessels, and a reticulin stain highlights concentric perivascular layering of reticulin fibers. By immunohistochemistry, the neoplastic cells are positive for CD20, BCL6, MUM1 and BCL2, negative for CD10, show c-MYC expression in a subset of cells and have a high Ki-67 proliferation index. Findings are consistent with primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the central nervous system, non-germinal center B-cell type, pending exclusion of systemic disease.

ddx.dx: Secondary CNS involvement by systemic DLBCL
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; separation requires staging to exclude systemic disease.
Glioblastoma shows GFAP-positive pleomorphic glial cells with microvascular proliferation and palisading necrosis and is CD20/CD45-negative.
Metastases form cohesive nests and are keratin- or SOX10/S100-positive and CD20-negative.
Immunodeficiency-associated or LYG lesions have a polymorphous background with angiodestruction, necrosis and EBER-positive B cells.

58.stain: H&E; reticulin; IHC: CD20, CD10, BCL6, MUM1, BCL2, MYC, Ki67
captions: H&E: sheets of large lymphoid cells cuffing a central vessel
H&E high power: large cells with vesicular chromatin, nucleoli and mitoses
H&E composite: brain parenchyma with perivascular tumor (1a), sheets of large cells (1b), vessel cuffing (1c), high power (1d)
Reticulin stain: concentric perivascular reticulin rings
IHC panel: CD20+, CD10-, BCL6+, MUM1+, BCL2+, c-MYC subset, high Ki-67

62586.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結結構被大量背靠背、大小相近、邊界模糊的結節取代，結節間只剩狹窄的淡粉紅色間隔，外套區不明顯、也看不到極性（明暗帶），呈濾泡性淋巴瘤的結節型生長；但第 3a 級需要高倍計數中心母細胞，本圖倍率無法判定分級。
features: Effacement of nodal architecture by closely packed, back-to-back nodules of similar size
Nodules poorly demarcated with attenuated or absent mantle zones
Loss of germinal center polarization (no dark/light zones) and absence of tingible-body macrophage 'starry-sky'
Narrow pale interfollicular areas with small vessels
Cytologic grading (centroblasts per HPF) not assessable at this low magnification
62586.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows architectural effacement by numerous closely packed, back-to-back neoplastic follicles of relatively uniform size with attenuated mantle zones and compressed interfollicular regions. The follicles lack polarization and a starry-sky pattern of tingible-body macrophages. Cytologic detail is insufficient at this magnification to count centroblasts, so grading requires high-power evaluation (grade 3A: >15 centroblasts per HPF with centrocytes still present). The architecture is consistent with follicular lymphoma, reported in this case as grade 3A.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, have well-formed mantle zones, polarization, tingible-body macrophages and are BCL2-negative in germinal centers.

ddx.dx: Follicular large B-cell lymphoma (former FL grade 3B)
ddx.vs: Grade 3B/FLBL shows solid sheets of centroblasts without residual centrocytes, which requires high-power assessment, and may be BCL2/CD10-negative.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: MZL shows interfollicular/perifollicular pale monocytoid cells colonizing follicles, with CD10-/BCL6- neoplastic cells and residual CD10+ germinal center remnants.
Nodular MCL consists of monotonous small centrocyte-like cells without centroblasts and is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.

1274.recognize_zh: 這是低倍周邊血液抹片，大量紅血球中散布極多數量一致的小型有核細胞，顯示明顯的淋巴球增多；此放大倍率看不到核仁、細胞質突起等細節，只能支持 T 前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）典型的高白血球數。
features: Low-power peripheral blood smear with marked leukocytosis
Numerous small, fairly uniform mononuclear cells evenly distributed among red cells
Cells appear small to medium with dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm at this magnification
No obvious large blasts, granulocytic left shift, or clumping
Nuclear detail, nucleoli, and cytoplasmic blebs cannot be assessed at this magnification
1274.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed of numerous small, relatively uniform mononuclear cells distributed evenly among the red cells. At this magnification the cytologic features that characterize prolymphocytes, such as a single prominent nucleolus, irregular nuclear contour, and cytoplasmic blebs, cannot be evaluated. The image supports a marked lymphocytosis but is not diagnostic on its own. Correlation with high-power morphology and flow cytometry (CD4+/CD7+ bright T cells) and TCL1A rearrangement is required to confirm T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are CD5+/CD23+/CD20 dim B cells with clumped chromatin and smudge cells, whereas T-PLL cells are T cells with nucleoli and TCL1 overexpression.
Show cerebriform or flower-shaped nuclei on high power, CD7 loss, and skin involvement or HTLV-1 positivity.
Blasts have fine immature chromatin and are TdT and CD1a positive, unlike mature TdT-negative T-PLL cells.
Shows polymorphous reactive lymphocytes with polyclonal T-cell populations and a milder lymphocyte count.

3130.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中數顆中小型淋巴樣細胞，染色質中度凝集，胞質少量藍色、邊緣略不規則，右上與右側細胞核有凹陷或不規則輪廓，符合 T 細胞前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）；本圖核仁不明顯，屬小細胞變異外觀，需流式確認 T 表型與 TCL1 重排。
features: Several small to medium lymphoid cells, larger than red cells
Round to irregular nuclei, with one cell showing a deeply indented/convoluted contour
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous in this field
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm with slightly irregular or blebbed margins
Background red cells with a few target-like forms; no smudge cells visible
3130.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with moderately condensed chromatin, scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm with irregular margins, and nuclear contours ranging from round to deeply indented. Distinct nucleoli are not well visualized, a feature seen in the small-cell variant of T-PLL. No smudge cells or blasts are identified. In conjunction with a mature T-cell immunophenotype (CD4+ or CD4+/CD8+, CD7 bright) and TCL1A or MTCP1 rearrangement, findings are consistent with T-prolymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclear folds with CD7 and CD26 loss and erythroderma, whereas T-PLL typically retains strong CD7 and carries inv(14)/t(14;14).
CLL cells have soccer-ball chromatin with smudge cells and are CD19+/CD5+/CD23+, lacking T-cell antigens.
ATLL shows multilobated 'flower cells', is HTLV-1 positive, and is often CD25 bright with CD7 loss.
T-LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and a CD8+/CD57+ cytotoxic phenotype.
